rows.label: abs:abstract
rows.statement: Compare clusters through exogenous bound burn, complete authored acts and a conserved same-epoch balance/count equilibrium, with public replay and terminal feed and reward readouts. Genuine contributing source and rival allocation do not imply funded-partition invariance. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration; a record-based remedy costs both the same under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``. The appendix retains six architectural extensions and no Layer-1 open problem.

rows.label: motto:motto
rows.statement: Track motto as a separately addressable motto.

rows.label: sec:introduction
rows.statement: Track introduction as a separately addressable section.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:captured-comparator
rows.statement: Track captured comparator as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: ins:introduction:every-platform-compares
rows.statement: Make the comparator inspectable, reproducible and contestable by those it measures; the objection is private ownership and hidden application of the measure, not comparison itself.

rows.label: ins:introduction:the-detector
rows.statement: Bound costless Sybil activity through resource cost rather than treating forgeable humanity proxies as a finished defense; a privileged identity detector both controls admission and extracts identity data.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:the-only-question
rows.statement: Track the only question as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: ins:introduction:who-owns-the-frame
rows.statement: Use an exogenous, neutral and public frame that no participant, including the operator, can own or price to favor its own interest.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:two-precedents
rows.statement: Track two precedents as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: ins:introduction:tcp-is-unpriced-neutrality
rows.statement: The frame source supplies a neutral substrate under common rules, without judging the worth of what it carries; worth is determined above that substrate.

rows.label: ins:introduction:wikipedia-is-public-auditability
rows.statement: Make the measurement reproducible and contestable from a public record by the agents it measures, in addition to using a neutral frame.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:dignity
rows.statement: Track dignity as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: ins:introduction:neutrality-is-dignity
rows.statement: Participants must be able to inspect and reproduce the measure of standing.

rows.label: ins:introduction:price-not-detector
rows.statement: Admission uses burn solvency and safety and participation floors rather than a humanity detector. Required Registration debit is distinct from incremental total burn between matched histories, which can be zero; pricing establishes no authenticity or partition guarantee. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: ins:introduction:equal-among-peers
rows.statement: Standing pools transported balances and action counts rather than averaging actor rates. Incoming action mass, not headcount, controls the limit; funded partitions can change retained denominators and individual standings. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: ins:introduction:no-escape-velocity
rows.statement: Certified fixed-rung relational support cannot be replaced by artifact routing. Separate responsive activation from final burn response: source rates and emission can rise without each standing increasing. The hull and response bounds do not give a universal participant-maximum guarantee. The same concentration record can describe a legitimately separate role under ``ex:epoch:split-showcase``; its magnitude does not reveal purpose.

rows.label: ins:introduction:peer-claim-scope
rows.statement: Incoming action mass controls peer convergence and an isolated actor retains its own source rate. Preserve the closed transported-count-weighted mean without claiming invariance of individual coordinates or participant maxima under funded partitions. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: ins:introduction:only-faithful-coordinate
rows.statement: Compare a two-sided closed community by its transported-count-weighted ledger ratio, not an arithmetic mean of rates or a total-reserve ranking. At fixed counts, accepted burn raises this mean; it does not determine each coordinate, reward or funded-partition maximum. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: ins:introduction:the-floor-we-name
rows.statement: Public accountability does not prove the truth of every graph claim.

rows.label: ins:introduction:the-cut-no-mechanism-can-make
rows.statement: Internal graph evidence cannot distinguish funded genuine participants from funded fabrications. Exclude unsupported standing through genuine contributing source and rival allocation. Legitimate separation and strategic concentration can share one public record, so a record-based remedy imposes the same cost on both under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``.

rows.label: ins:introduction:vouch-not-check
rows.statement: Record accountable authored vouches without recording or certifying private identity checks.

rows.label: ins:introduction:right-to-leave
rows.statement: Payload erasure preserves relied-upon structure; outside knowledge and structural distinctiveness can identify a departed Actor, and no degree of anonymity is promised.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:two-layers-derived
rows.statement: Layer 1 reads the external burn interface and publishes reproducible conserved standing while guilds own terminal readouts. Terminal independence and binding replay do not establish strategic partition invariance. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: tbl:introduction:layer-roles
rows.statement: Separate external frame supply, network binding, and terminal consumer roles.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:the-graph
rows.statement: Track the graph as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:infrastructure
rows.statement: Track infrastructure as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: post:introduction:public-accessibility
rows.statement: Graph and ledger remain publicly readable without authentication.

rows.label: post:introduction:record-integrity
rows.statement: Published records and ledger entries cannot be silently changed.

rows.label: post:introduction:irrevocability
rows.statement: Retain irreversible ledger history and monotone pinned imported burn amounts.

rows.label: post:introduction:authoritative-act-order
rows.statement: Publish a dependency-respecting total act order whose positions define logical times.

rows.label: post:introduction:epoch-edge-set
rows.statement: Each boundary supplies a finite monotone causally closed edge set.

rows.label: rem:introduction:mechanism-agnostic
rows.statement: Any provider mechanism must establish agreement on the ordered acts as well as the edge set.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:comparator-previewed
rows.statement: Derive residual balance/count sources from the ledger, weigh complete acts, and solve the conserved transport mediant with a known source-rate hull and public replay. Universal burn monotonicity is false; anchor sign claims need fixed emission. Partition bounds retain the premises of ``prop:epoch:split-pair-displacement`` and ``prop:epoch:split-concentration``; ``ex:epoch:split-small`` and ``ex:epoch:split-showcase`` give indistinguishable purpose completions of one record.

rows.label: ins:introduction:comparator-made-human
rows.statement: Feed and reward are terminal readings of the same standing field; neither may own its frame or redirect another actor source through passive structure. Preserve public, actor-authored relational inputs and reproducibility.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:verification-model
rows.statement: Audit and gated phases share public formulas; verify complete ledger and acts, folds, allocation, emission and each attempted rung, then certify residuals. Within-epoch convergence establishes neither inter-epoch tracking nor consent.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:reading-guide
rows.statement: Track reading guide as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: sec:comparator
rows.statement: Track comparator as a separately addressable section.

rows.label: subsec:comparator:the-axis
rows.statement: Track the axis as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: ax:comparator:inter-cluster
rows.statement: A meaningful comparison requires exogenous source rather than topology alone.

rows.label: rem:comparator:topology-is-gauge
rows.statement: Graph geometry alone cannot certify costly source.

rows.label: rem:comparator:actor-field-cluster-comparison
rows.statement: Publish actor standing without prescribing social cluster partitions or aggregation.

rows.label: subsec:comparator:burn-primitive
rows.statement: Track burn primitive as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:comparator:burn-primitive
rows.statement: The imported primitive must record costly irreversible publicly verifiable destruction.

rows.label: def:comparator:burn-interface
rows.statement: Expose the burn-amount map, opaque addresses, bootstrap capacity and positive unit-cost projection with its external denomination and terms; audit evidence and marker policy add no monetary input.

rows.label: post:comparator:burn-primitive
rows.statement: Require each labelled burn-realization obligation, including settlement, provenance, nontransferability, capacity, cost and conditional operator evidence.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-exogenous-origin
rows.statement: Import burn amounts from outside the graph; no graph-derived rule or network operation may compute or write them.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-neutrality
rows.statement: Treat the primitive as a uniform measurement of destroyed magnitude, not a priced asset, redemption right, entitlement or selection of a winner.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-non-transferability
rows.statement: Keep each recorded destruction amount at its original address, with recoverable attribution and no duplicate contribution; this does not prohibit standing relocation, pooling or concentration through alternative funded histories. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-settlement-amount
rows.statement: Pin nonnegative burn amounts at settlement with nondecreasing pins and conservative intermediate publication, subject to the specified history-replacement floor.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-settlement-pin
rows.statement: Pin the burn amount at a settlement event.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-pinned-monotonicity
rows.statement: Require successive pinned amounts at an address to be nondecreasing, with append-only records and nonnegative contributions.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-conservative-publication
rows.statement: Between settlements, publish no amount greater than the amount pinned by the next settlement.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-revision-floor
rows.statement: Permit downward revision no lower than the last settled pin when an alternative history omits a not-yet-final boundary; never revise below that pin.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-settlement-depth
rows.statement: Publish settlement depth and its finality assumptions: beyond that depth no history containing a settlement boundary is replaced, and an amount sampled at or below it equals its pinned amount.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-bindability
rows.statement: Supply opaque permanent addresses carrying no identity claim, so a consumer can bind its identities for the lifetime of its record.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-non-negativity
rows.statement: Require every address’s burn amount to lie on the same nonnegative real line.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-provenance-auditability
rows.statement: Anchor each contributing unit to genuine irrecoverable destruction and cap each recording event by its backing destruction; an unbacked record contributes zero. Publish enough quantities to recompute and verify provenance rather than merely total records.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-costly-append-only-record
rows.statement: Price destruction at its occurrence, preserve its record and provide no reverse map to the destroyed resource.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-bootstrap-capacity
rows.statement: Publish the nonnegative pre-opening capacity bound; an empty interval when external acquisition is possible from the start requires zero with its explanation, not a bound on later burns.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-unit-cost-projection
rows.statement: Publish a positive amount-proportional unit cost with external denomination and terms; publish recording-event costs separately as audit evidence. Destruction provenance supplies neither normalization nor a lower bound of one.

rows.label: cond:comparator:burn-operator-audit-bound
rows.statement: Publish the proved bound and proof for an operator accruing burn amount from operating the realization, or publish the absence of such a role with its explanation.

rows.label: post:comparator:marker-bound-settlement
rows.statement: Fix a public pre-genesis marker policy for its sequence, with open placement and cadence, and recognize settlement only under the lineage, acceptance, causal-dependence and single-count conditions.

rows.label: cond:comparator:marker-lineage-succession
rows.statement: Recognize an initial marker with index zero, no predecessor and empty accepted set and snapshot, followed by unique immediate successors with growing lineage, fixed policy and interpretation, and published depth and finality assumptions.

rows.label: cond:comparator:marker-network-acceptance
rows.statement: Recover each finite accepted set publicly under the fixed policy, containing predecessor acceptance and contained in marker lineage; verify every destruction, amount and address without omissions or repairs.

rows.label: cond:comparator:marker-causal-dependence
rows.statement: A marker depends on its predecessor and entire lineage; a history losing a lineage record cannot retain the same marker even by copying its written contents.

rows.label: cond:comparator:marker-single-count
rows.statement: Count each underlying destruction at first acceptance only, despite aliases, repeated references, later markers or attempts to change attribution.

rows.label: def:comparator:marker-burn-snapshot
rows.statement: Derive each address amount by summing distinct destructions first represented in accepted sets through the recognized marker; an older lineage record may first contribute later.

rows.label: eq:comparator:marker-burn-snapshot
rows.statement: Sum first-accepted destruction amounts by attributed address from the empty initial snapshot, deriving the gross increment from newly counted destructions.

rows.label: prop:comparator:marker-settlement-consistency
rows.statement: The same recognized final marker and fixed policy determine the same accepted sets, gross snapshot and increment; monotonicity is within one history and does not assert residual-balance monotonicity or liveness.

rows.label: subsec:comparator:imported-frame
rows.statement: Track imported frame as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:comparator:imported-frame
rows.statement: Read a shared nonnegative burn-amount codomain at each permanently bound actor address.

rows.label: eq:comparator:seam
rows.statement: Resolve an actor burn amount through its bound primitive address.

rows.label: rem:comparator:neutrality-from-silence
rows.statement: The imported destruction record confers no primitive-level priced claim.

rows.label: def:comparator:frame-binding
rows.statement: Keep each actor permanently bound to its opaque burn address. Bind recorded burn permanently to its address; standing is a separate computed quantity, and address portfolios can concentrate received support. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: rem:comparator:destination-funding-non-transferability
rows.statement: Allow destination-funded new accrual without transferring recorded source or identifying its funder; this promises no standing invariance across alternative address portfolios. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: rem:comparator:identity-is-layer-2
rows.statement: Do not represent the person associated with an actor in Layer 1.

rows.label: lem:comparator:frame-stability
rows.statement: Settled gross burn amounts do not decrease along the recognized marker sequence in one history under its fixed policy.

rows.label: rem:comparator:auditability
rows.statement: Verify destruction provenance rather than treating a sum of records as sufficient burn evidence.

rows.label: subsec:comparator:the-source
rows.statement: Track the source as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:comparator:rate
rows.statement: Divide residual balance by the greater of cumulative accepted-act count and one.

rows.label: eq:comparator:rate
rows.statement: Compute the neutral source from residual balance and guarded count.

rows.label: def:comparator:residual-balance
rows.statement: Subtract historical consummated debits at their original epoch prices from imported burn.

rows.label: eq:comparator:residual-balance
rows.statement: Calculate residual burn as imported burn amount less the debit schedule.

rows.label: rem:comparator:vintage-trichotomy
rows.statement: Preserve recorded parameters and debit vintages while reading carried balances under current constants.

rows.label: rem:comparator:vintage-recorded-parameters
rows.statement: Keep the parameters recorded by each accepted record unchanged.

rows.label: rem:comparator:vintage-read-time-state
rows.statement: Evaluate current carried burn-denominated state, including the burn balance, under the constants in force when it is read.

rows.label: rem:comparator:vintage-consummated-debits
rows.statement: Retain each consummated per-act debit at the price charged by its accepted epoch; never recalculate it.

rows.label: rem:comparator:type-asymmetry
rows.statement: Distinguish burn magnitudes from integer counts and reduce through the numeraire.

rows.label: def:comparator:numeraire
rows.statement: Use a positive burn-per-action numeraire as the sole dimensional conversion.

rows.label: subsec:comparator:two-costs
rows.statement: Track two costs as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: ins:comparator:inherited-costliness
rows.statement: Treat costliness and provenance as obligations supplied by the realization.

rows.label: def:comparator:source-faithful
rows.statement: Separate inherited actor-source authenticity from the bounded truth of edge claims.

rows.label: cond:comparator:source-actor-mass
rows.statement: Require contributing Actor mass to be genuinely destroyed and non-transferable across addresses, with instantaneous-costliness grounding at genesis and net-cost grounding after a market exists. Treat this as an inherited primitive obligation.

rows.label: cond:comparator:source-edge-event
rows.statement: Internal title recognition and positive folded coordinates qualify counterparty allocation but do not authenticate an external event or referent; endogenous accountability leaves that semantic limit structurally bounded. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: post:comparator:accountability-cost
rows.statement: Keep attributed immutable claims and their endogenous accountability cost; internal corroboration cannot establish external truth or supply an authenticity test.

rows.label: tbl:comparator:two-costs
rows.statement: Distinguish exogenous source cost from endogenous accountability cost.

rows.label: subsec:comparator:faithfulness
rows.statement: Track faithfulness as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: post:comparator:faithfulness
rows.statement: Enforce source, dimensional, immutable-ledger, conservation, epoch-set, title, memoryless, universal, domain, tilt, cluster-rate and final-state clauses.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-source
rows.statement: Require real, irrecoverable contributing mass bound to its Actor; source provenance does not make standing coordinates invariant under funded address partition. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-numeraire
rows.statement: Divide every burn-denominated input by the numeraire before combining it with a count.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-measurement
rows.statement: Compute standing as a measurement of the record, not a possessed ledger asset; the ledger after measurement must equal the ledger before it.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-conservation
rows.statement: Conserve full balance and count totals through row-stochastic allocation; this is rival allocation, not invariance of individual standings, participant maxima or unweighted sums. The receiving-family concentration of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration`` remains compatible with these scoped invariants.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-epoch-set
rows.statement: Keep host-assigned order, relation frontiers and intra-epoch latest positions out of every standing quantity.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-title
rows.statement: Resolve a settlement act’s counterparty allocation only through the epoch title fold.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-memorylessness
rows.statement: Use no previous epoch’s standing as a semantic input.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-universal-act-weighing
rows.statement: Weigh every accepted Actor-authored act exactly once, resolving to a person or self; consume matched hyper-acts atomically so unmatched legs and passive artifacts carry no standing. Admissible partitions can change author-indexed folds and normalized allocation, so invariance needs additional premises. The all-state hop-intertwining premises of ``thm:dynamics:split-hop-refinement`` are a sufficient invariance criterion, not a consequence of act partition alone.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-domain-weights
rows.statement: Apply declared domain weights to complete folded acts; preserving aggregate ledger pairs does not by itself preserve the resulting author-indexed allocation. The all-state hop-intertwining premises of ``thm:dynamics:split-hop-refinement`` are a sufficient invariance criterion, not a consequence of act partition alone.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-responsive-tilt
rows.statement: Use recipient standing only to modulate relative authored allocation, with hop fading at the greatest certified rung.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-cluster-rate
rows.statement: Preserve the closed transported-count-weighted mean under internal pair allocation; neither an open fibre mean nor individual coordinates or maxima are thereby fixed. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: cond:comparator:faithfulness-final-set-admission
rows.statement: Require final-set admission to read only the completed post-debit standing result; this is a boundary-operator obligation, not a consequence of the standing construction. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: ins:comparator:universal-amplifier
rows.statement: Terminal value channels use dimensionless standing amplification without manufacturing source. Use published standing in terminal formulas only under their fixed-context premises; terminal scalar monotonicity does not imply monotonicity under a burn, act or funded partition. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: rem:comparator:amplifier-rendering
rows.statement: Terminal amplification must not silently become an admission-policy control. Zero standing retains unit amplification; an optional guild exponent is published with canonical default one. Terminal input monotonicity implies no monotone burn, act or partition response. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: rem:comparator:conserved-allocation-scope
rows.statement: Conservation excludes passive or unowned redirection and makes source allocation rival, including against self, but supplies no target veto. General funded-partition standing invariance is false even with proportional pairs and unchanged incoming acts. Pair totals, closed weighted means and equal-rate regimes survive; displacement bounds are not small strategic-gain guarantees. Concentration and invariant claims require ``prop:epoch:split-concentration`` and ``thm:dynamics:split-hop-refinement``; contraction bounds residual amplification, not residual size.

rows.label: cor:comparator:sybil-resistance-is-faithfulness
rows.statement: Sybil resistance means no standing without genuine contributing source and rival allocation of existing source; it promises no invariance when one participant funds several addresses. Under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``, a record-based remedy imposes the same change on a legitimate completion with identical public fields, or the same distribution of changes if randomized.

rows.label: subsec:comparator:capacity-and-admission-benchmarks
rows.statement: Track capacity and admission benchmarks as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:comparator:bootstrap-capacity
rows.statement: Carry the published aggregate pre-opening burn-amount bound without deriving it; publish zero and an explanation when external acquisition is possible from the start. The aggregate ceiling restricts amount, not the allocation of that amount among funded addresses. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: eq:comparator:admission-benchmark-deposits
rows.statement: Multiply unsupported-act burn benchmarks by the realization unit-cost projection.

rows.label: tbl:comparator:admission-benchmarks
rows.statement: Check debit-only, safety and door-neutral unsupported-act costs separately.

rows.label: subsec:comparator:the-surface
rows.statement: Track the surface as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: rem:comparator:network-prices-the-frame
rows.statement: Derive standing from imported source without importing a realization monetary mechanism.

rows.label: rem:comparator:surface-readings
rows.statement: Exclude monetary-surface prices, announcement timing and operator attribution from computation; retain only the burn-interface inputs and separately required public audit evidence.

rows.label: subsec:comparator:limitations
rows.statement: Track limitations as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: rem:comparator:inherited-limitations
rows.statement: Holding all external supply does not establish zero net burn cost; neither destruction provenance nor the unit-cost projection determines holdings-adjusted cost, and nontransferability alone supplies no actor-splitting guarantee. Recorded-amount non-transferability is not standing immobility; required Registration debit differs from incremental total burn between matched histories. Under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``, a record-based remedy imposes the same change on a legitimate completion with identical public fields, or the same distribution of changes if randomized.

rows.label: rem:comparator:structural-ceiling
rows.statement: Separate consistent marker snapshots from external truth: title-coupled counterparty allocation requires recognition, while even valid title transfers cannot authenticate the asserted event or referent.

rows.label: sec:network
rows.statement: Track network as a separately addressable section.

rows.label: subsec:network:the-write
rows.statement: Track the write as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:network:write
rows.statement: Publish the accepted ordered act sequence and its whole dependent-set projections only after final-state validity.

rows.label: rem:network:not-a-write
rows.statement: Do not publish rejected candidates, solver iterates, derived edges or payload reductions as writes.

rows.label: subsec:network:admission-closure
rows.statement: Track admission closure as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:network:admission-closure
rows.statement: Classify every value by whether its arithmetic or validity read-sites feed admission.

rows.label: case:network:admission-closure-binding
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:network:admission-closure``: An object that influences admission lies in the admission closure and is binding: consumers must use its published value, though they may recompute it for audit.

rows.label: case:network:admission-closure-free
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:network:admission-closure``: An object is free only when every read-site is terminal and never feeds forward epoch evolution; guild reimplementation is then permitted. Recomputability alone does not make a binding object free.

rows.label: case:network:admission-closure-title-feedback
rows.statement: Title read by settlement authorization is a feedback input and therefore binding, even though the title fold is deterministic and auditable.

rows.label: case:network:admission-closure-title-terminal
rows.statement: Guild routing through the owner Self-edge is a terminal title read, but title remains binding because recognition also reads it; guilds must not disagree on the owner used for later settlements.

rows.label: rem:network:boundary-one-sentence
rows.statement: Keep ledger, formation, title-coupled standing resolution and admission binding; raw routing and terminal interpretations cannot replace that binding meaning.

rows.label: subsec:network:object-taxonomy
rows.statement: Track object taxonomy as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:network:object-taxonomy
rows.statement: Distinguish imported, binding, verification, optional byproduct and terminal objects.

rows.label: def:network:conserved-standing-package
rows.statement: Publish completed inputs, fold/base data, activation, rung history, transport, emissions, standing and reproduction evidence.

rows.label: itm:network:conserved-standing-package-final-state
rows.statement: Publish the proposed final epoch state: final edge set, residual balances, action counts, settled burn snapshot and constants in force.

rows.label: itm:network:conserved-standing-package-folds
rows.statement: Publish fold cells and coefficients, each cell’s recipient resolution, the domain weights and the base allocation matrix they determine.

rows.label: itm:network:conserved-standing-package-activation
rows.statement: Publish responsive and wall-clamped activation formulas, the in-force wall and structural floor, and controller edition and reduced constants. Include the completed width and accepted rung as controller inputs beside its wall, proposal, delivered next wall and burn-image schedule.

rows.label: itm:network:conserved-standing-package-tilt
rows.statement: Publish the tilt profile, backoff grid, accepted rung and certificate verdict of every higher rung attempted.

rows.label: itm:network:conserved-standing-package-transport
rows.statement: Publish the depth masses, hop allocation matrices and conserved transport they compose at the equilibrium.

rows.label: itm:network:conserved-standing-package-emission
rows.statement: Publish each source’s emission fraction even though it is derivable from the final state, so its transport reach can be audited directly.

rows.label: itm:network:conserved-standing-package-certificate
rows.statement: Publish the rate-hull box, standing certificate and verdict, fixed-point enclosure, final standing and stamps, door headroom, and own-balance, individual-safety and epoch-admission verdicts.

rows.label: itm:network:conserved-standing-package-evidence
rows.statement: Publish interval boxes, residual bounds and other evidence sufficient to check the mathematical claims independently; these prove the binding package and are not separate standing inputs.

rows.label: tbl:network:object-taxonomy
rows.statement: Apply the five permission classes to published values according to their read-sites.

rows.label: rem:network:taxonomy-subtleties
rows.statement: Separate binding certificate verdicts from evidence and never let optional caches feed binding outputs.

rows.label: rem:network:within-epoch-solve-freeze
rows.statement: Freeze the completed-set base matrix and ledger-derived emissions throughout a solve.

rows.label: subsec:network:host-contract
rows.statement: Track host contract as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: post:network:host-contract
rows.statement: Publish the complete package with the fixed marker policy, verified accepted burn snapshot and evidence, and decisive standing enclosures without hidden state or normative digests.

rows.label: itm:network:host-contract-accepted-records
rows.statement: At each accepted boundary publish the final write and edge sets, the dependent-set partition obtained by merging overlapping principal closures against prior finalized history, realized size, closure cause and attested boundary timestamp.

rows.label: itm:network:host-contract-final-ledger
rows.statement: Publish settled boundary burn state, final residual balances and action counts, accepted-act count increments and debit vintages.

rows.label: itm:network:host-contract-semantic-projection
rows.statement: Publish every accepted Actor-authored act, its fold cell and coefficient, recipient resolution and inviter revocation, together with the base allocation determined under the published domain weights.

rows.label: itm:network:host-contract-transport
rows.statement: Publish the tilt profile, accepted rung and PASS, FAIL or INDECISIVE verdict for every higher attempted rung, depth masses, emission fractions and conserved transport.

rows.label: itm:network:host-contract-final-standing
rows.statement: Publish the rate-hull box, standing certificate, fixed-point enclosure, final standing, action and epoch stamps, door headroom and all three write-gate verdicts.

rows.label: itm:network:host-contract-shared-policy
rows.statement: Publish title and settlement recognition, target size and duration bounds, the policy-floor schedule (announced at boundary k and effective at k+1, valid if and only if at or above the safety wall), the threshold schedule, and the margin. Publish the in-force wall and fixed structural-floor declaration beside the numeraire before the first epoch, including its exact defining object and comparison procedure; include controller edition, reduced constants, completed width and rung, proposal and delivered led wall. No protocol formula changes silently.

rows.label: itm:network:host-contract-evidence
rows.statement: Publish formula editions, constants, interval boxes, residual bounds and reports sufficient for any participant to rerun the host calculation.

rows.label: def:network:door-headroom
rows.statement: Sum final stamp surplus once per accepted act as a non-actuating diagnostic.

rows.label: rem:network:durations-no-glyph
rows.statement: Publish duration policy, closure cause and attested timestamp without inventing a formula-derived clock.

rows.label: ins:network:back-pressure
rows.statement: Separate epoch budget and timing selection from the greatest-certifiable-rung search.

rows.label: sec:graph
rows.statement: Track graph as a separately addressable section.

rows.label: subsec:graph:edge-ontology
rows.statement: Track edge ontology as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: ax:graph:authored-act-ontology
rows.statement: Accepted acts own all authoritative fields and project to edges; nodes and their properties are derived readings.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-ownership-invariant
rows.statement: An edge projection cannot independently change any parent-owned approval, payload, debit or clock.

rows.label: cor:graph:hyper-act-indivisibility
rows.statement: Both hyper-act projections share exactly one lifecycle and accounting unit.

rows.label: rem:graph:ontology-promotion
rows.statement: Treat accepted acts as authored history and every edge as a derived projection.

rows.label: def:graph:identifier-algebra
rows.statement: Represent addresses, profiles, exact names and act-minted identifiers as disjoint constructors.

rows.label: def:graph:authored-act
rows.statement: Represent one atomic act with one binary or two matched hyper-edge projections.

rows.label: case:graph:authored-act-binary
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:authored-act``: A binary authored act projects to exactly one edge record and remains one atomic unit of formation, admission, ordering, counting and debit.

rows.label: case:graph:authored-act-hyper
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:authored-act``: A hyper-edge act projects to exactly two matched records, one A-leg and one T-leg; accept neither other cardinalities nor per-leg counting or debiting. It carries one dependency projection for the whole act.

rows.label: def:graph:act-identifier
rows.statement: Form identity from author, local sequence and family before host time or target minting.

rows.label: lem:graph:identifier-disjointness
rows.statement: Decide identifier class from its constructor without a lookup.

rows.label: def:graph:anchoring
rows.statement: Distinguish reference from class-specific anchoring and dangling state.

rows.label: lem:graph:dangling-neutral-fold
rows.statement: Return neutral folds for referenced identifiers lacking their required anchor.

rows.label: def:graph:node-taxonomy
rows.statement: Classify grounded Actor/Profile, named Type and six minted artifact kinds.

rows.label: rem:graph:name-equality
rows.statement: Compare names by exact bytes without Unicode normalization or case folding.

rows.label: def:graph:genesis-act-and-creator
rows.statement: Detect self-minting genesis roles and derive creators by identifier class.

rows.label: case:graph:genesis-act-and-creator-genesis-role
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:genesis-act-and-creator``: An act of a genesis family has the genesis role exactly when its terminal target is mint of its own act identifier; decide this by syntactic equality of the act fields.

rows.label: case:graph:genesis-act-and-creator-ordinary-role
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:genesis-act-and-creator``: An act of a genesis family whose terminal target is not its own mint has ordinary role: it names an existing node and neither mints, fixes the creator, establishes genesis context nor roots title.

rows.label: case:graph:genesis-act-and-creator-minted-creator
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:genesis-act-and-creator``: For a minted node, resolve its creator to the author of its genesis act.

rows.label: case:graph:genesis-act-and-creator-address-creator
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:genesis-act-and-creator``: For an address node addr(a), resolve its creator to that address node itself.

rows.label: case:graph:genesis-act-and-creator-profile-creator
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:genesis-act-and-creator``: For a profile node prof(a), resolve its creator to addr(a).

rows.label: case:graph:genesis-act-and-creator-named-creator
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:genesis-act-and-creator``: For a named node name(s), creator is absent; assign absent-creator standing zero and the neutral feed amplifier one. Named concepts have no owner.

rows.label: def:graph:registration
rows.statement: Anchor an existing grounded Actor/Profile pair through an ordinary priced act.

rows.label: def:graph:derived-raw-edges
rows.statement: Derive current raw Self readings from accepted standing without appending records.

rows.label: def:graph:raw-traversal-snapshot
rows.statement: Combine accepted edges with current derived Self readings for terminal traversal only.

rows.label: def:graph:derived-self-reading
rows.statement: Derive both Self components from the same reduced standing and tenure maturity.

rows.label: def:graph:raw-snapshot-path
rows.statement: Use bounded simple paths in the current raw snapshot without increasing-time constraints.

rows.label: thm:graph:raw-weight-ceiling
rows.statement: Raw canonical edge weights are nonnegative and strictly below one.

rows.label: case:graph:raw-weight-ceiling-positive-walk
rows.statement: Branch of ``thm:graph:raw-weight-ceiling`` proof: Because every routing-live raw edge has weight below one, removing a repeated-node cycle from a positive-weight walk strictly improves its product and shortens it. This simplification is not valid for a fixed parity register.

rows.label: case:graph:raw-weight-ceiling-zero-walk
rows.statement: Branch of ``thm:graph:raw-weight-ceiling`` proof: Removing a cycle from a zero-weight walk cannot decrease its product; repeated removal gives a simple path within the same upper depth bound when parity is unconstrained. Removing a negative-parity cycle changes the sign, so this argument supplies no fixed-parity simplification.

rows.label: def:graph:canonical-folds
rows.statement: Derive declared node properties from records and keep title binding while terminal folds remain replaceable.

rows.label: rem:graph:stance-records-by-family
rows.statement: Exclude control and derived records from stance means but retain genesis stance fields.

rows.label: lem:graph:act-edge-identifier-uniqueness
rows.statement: Reject duplicate accepted act and projection identities as equivocation.

rows.label: ax:graph:parallel-authored-acts
rows.statement: Retain parallel acts individually without rejection, merging or implicit supersession.

rows.label: def:graph:authored-act-bundle
rows.statement: Group complete acts by author, incidence and family without reconstructing acts from unrelated legs.

rows.label: def:graph:act-edge-projection
rows.statement: Project one parent act into role-consistent edges inheriting its single time and semantic tuple.

rows.label: case:graph:act-edge-projection-binary-count
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:act-edge-projection``: A binary act has exactly one edge projection, with identity derived from its parent act identifier and binary role.

rows.label: case:graph:act-edge-projection-hyper-count
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:act-edge-projection``: A hyper-edge act has exactly two projections with A and T roles, agreeing author, family, incidence and family parameters, sharing one act time and parent identifier. A missing leg is malformed or incompletely retrieved, never a partially accepted act.

rows.label: rem:graph:authored-act-bundle-consumers
rows.statement: Reserve binding bundle interpretations to standing compilation and title recognition.

rows.label: rem:graph:terminal-folds-alter-nothing
rows.statement: Terminal selection leaves all accepted records live for accounting and binding consumers.

rows.label: post:graph:title-act-bundle-reservation
rows.statement: Resolve settlement bundles at epoch granularity with cancellation dominance and mutual consumption.

rows.label: rem:graph:profile-update
rows.statement: A parallel Registration updates payload history without rebinding identity.

rows.label: def:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head
rows.statement: Terminal revision selection follows public ancestry and preserves the incumbent across branches.

rows.label: case:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head-unique-maximal
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head``: Within the root-reachable revision acts, a unique causal-parent-maximal act is the revision head; with only the root, read its payload.

rows.label: case:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head-incumbent
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head``: When root-reachable revision acts have several maximal elements, keep the deepest common causal ancestor as incumbent; do not break the branch tie by order. Acts without a root chain are fold-ignored but remain admitted and priced in other consumers.

rows.label: case:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head-genesis-root
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head``: For Content, Comment and Message, root the chain-ordered revision fold at the genesis act.

rows.label: case:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head-registration-root
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head``: For Profile, root the revision fold at its anchoring Registration, which is grounded and mints nothing.

rows.label: case:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head-prior-head-root
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head``: For Item, use the genesis act or the title-holder author own prior head as root; title chooses the author and causal ancestry orders that author acts, so a new owner first description is not lost for lacking a same-author genesis chain.

rows.label: prop:graph:revision-head-order-invariance
rows.statement: The canonical terminal revision head is independent of valid host linearization.

rows.label: rem:graph:chain-requirement-sited-in-fold
rows.statement: Do not add revision-chain lookups to syntactic formation or turn declared parents into scoring incidence.

rows.label: def:graph:canonical-erasure-default
rows.statement: The terminal default selects structurally before rendering and never falls back from a reduced head.

rows.label: rem:graph:parallel-undefined
rows.statement: Do not invent additional binding interpretations of parallel records.

rows.label: rem:graph:grounded-target-does-not-imply-allocation
rows.statement: A grounded endpoint alone cannot confer standing authority.

rows.label: rem:graph:right-to-leave-completed
rows.statement: Keep removable content separate from immutable relied-upon structure for every act kind.

rows.label: subsec:graph:partition-and-passivity
rows.statement: Track partition and passivity as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:partition
rows.statement: Derive active Actor and passive artifact partitions from projected records.

rows.label: ax:graph:passivity
rows.statement: Every accepted act has an Actor author and passive nodes cannot autonomously redirect edges.

rows.label: itm:graph:passivity-authorship
rows.statement: Require every recorded edge to have an active Actor author: an Actor-sourced edge is authored by its source, while a passive-sourced edge is a terminal hyper-edge leg authored by the act’s Actor. Reputation is derived, not an exception allowing passive-authored records.

rows.label: case:graph:passivity-source-actor
rows.statement: Branch of ``ax:graph:passivity``: An edge whose source is an Actor is authored by that source Actor.

rows.label: case:graph:passivity-passive-terminal-leg
rows.statement: Branch of ``ax:graph:passivity``: A record sourced from a passive node must be the T-leg of an Actor-authored hyper-edge; no third authorship case exists. Reputation is derived, not a record exception.

rows.label: itm:graph:passivity-non-autonomy
rows.statement: Permit no passive node to initiate, redirect or modify an edge; its outgoing recorded legs are fixed by the Actor at creation and remain immutable.

rows.label: prop:graph:author-source-identity
rows.statement: The initiating source, identifier author and authenticated actor must agree.

rows.label: lem:graph:passive-out-degree
rows.statement: Passive outgoing projections are authored hyper-act terminal legs plus the separate raw Profile reading.

rows.label: rem:graph:asymmetry
rows.statement: An actor-directed act implies no reciprocal act or symmetric parameters.

rows.label: subsec:graph:temporal-structure
rows.statement: Track temporal structure as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: ax:graph:act-causality
rows.statement: Assign one act-level Lamport event and enforce earlier parents and dependencies.

rows.label: def:graph:act-incidence-causality
rows.statement: Compute binary or three-way incidence frontiers and pair Lamport time with host position.

rows.label: case:graph:act-incidence-causality-incident-update
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:act-incidence-causality``: After an act, advance every endpoint in its incidence set to that act frontier; both hyper-edge legs inherit the same event time.

rows.label: case:graph:act-incidence-causality-unchanged-endpoint
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:act-incidence-causality``: For an endpoint outside an act incidence set, retain its preceding frontier unchanged.

rows.label: rem:graph:causal-frontier-not-ancestry
rows.statement: Never infer a causal parent solely from a smaller clock.

rows.label: def:graph:edge-projection-maturity
rows.statement: Compute each projection maturity from shared pre-act endpoint degree without sibling self-maturation.

rows.label: def:graph:authoritative-act-order
rows.statement: Retain total host order and its causal key while checking declared precedence.

rows.label: rem:graph:host-ordering-discretion
rows.statement: Publish residual host ordering choices without promising incentive-neutral order.

rows.label: prop:graph:act-clock-path-order
rows.statement: The stated projected-path rule requires increasing act keys except within one hyper-act.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-time-not-wall-clock
rows.statement: Compute logical timing and maturity without substituting wall-clock time.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-ordering-relations
rows.statement: Keep public parents distinct from removable dependencies and exclude both from direct scoring incidence.

rows.label: rem:graph:maturity-max-rationale
rows.statement: The canonical maturity uses maximum endpoint degree to retain sparse-to-dense context.

rows.label: prop:graph:maturity-bounds
rows.statement: Finite-degree maturity remains in the half-open unit interval and grows with degree.

rows.label: def:graph:temporal-entropy
rows.statement: Evaluate binary entropy of maturity with the zero endpoint totalized.

rows.label: subsec:graph:separable-commitment
rows.statement: Track separable commitment as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:act-payload-projection
rows.statement: Carry one bounded opaque payload per act with a retained commitment and removable opening.

rows.label: post:graph:separable-act-projections
rows.statement: Require independently verifiable structure and binding concealing payload residue with atomic opening removal.

rows.label: def:graph:act-payload-state
rows.statement: Distinguish full-empty, full and reduced payload states with one-way reduction.

rows.label: prop:graph:removable-projection-invariance
rows.statement: Payload or dependency tombstones preserve structural identities and all computed binding quantities.

rows.label: def:graph:act-payload-controller
rows.statement: Assign payload removal control to the act author, never independently to a leg.

rows.label: rem:graph:payload-size-not-act-cost
rows.statement: Charge one act regardless of its bounded payload size.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-payload-removal-neutrality
rows.statement: Replay standing and title identically with full or reduced content.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-payload-custody-phases
rows.statement: Change carriage responsibility across phases while retaining the same witness and structural record.

rows.label: rem:graph:erasure-floor
rows.statement: Retain concealing residue and do not promise erasure of other authors' quotations or proof of payload authorship.

rows.label: subsec:graph:sentiment-slice
rows.statement: Track sentiment slice as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:sentiment-slice
rows.statement: Construct the masked three-by-three slice with always-active marginals and baseline.

rows.label: eq:graph:sentiment-slice
rows.statement: Construct the masked three-by-three slice with always-active marginals and baseline.

rows.label: rem:graph:marginal-archetypes
rows.statement: Check that strong marginal direction survives weak bilinear intensity.

rows.label: subsec:graph:rank-two-structure
rows.statement: Track rank two structure as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: prop:graph:rank-two-constraint
rows.statement: Check mask-dependent singular-value bounds rather than assuming exact rank two after clamping.

rows.label: itm:graph:rank-two-constraint-unmasked-rank
rows.statement: Check that the unclamped, unmasked sentiment slice is exactly rank one, as the outer product of its intensity and domain vectors with their absolute values and unit entries.

rows.label: itm:graph:rank-two-constraint-masked-bound
rows.statement: After clamping and masking, check the smallest-to-largest singular-value ratio against the effective-mask bounds: full mask below 0.05, Identity at most 0.14, Epistemic and Economic at most 0.10, Minimal at most 0.22. The full-mask evidence is a 21-by-21 numerical grid; Identity and Minimal attain their bounds at the extremal corner, while Epistemic and Economic maxima are interior and their corner ratio is zero.

rows.label: prop:graph:rank-two-constraint:energy-share
rows.statement: Check the claimed two-singular-value energy shares by mask.

rows.label: case:graph:rank-two-constraint-full-mask
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:graph:rank-two-constraint`` proof: For the full stored mask, clamping breaks exact rank-one proportionality. The reference singular values and the 21 by 21 grid numerically support the third-to-first ratio bound at sampled points; neither the interpolation gap nor a closed-form bound is certified by that grid.

rows.label: case:graph:rank-two-constraint-restricted-mask
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:graph:rank-two-constraint`` proof: Restricted masks inject genuine rank-three content. Identity and Minimal attain their bounds at the extremal corner; Epistemic and Economic have zero third singular value there and interior maxima confirmed on the sampled grid.

rows.label: ins:graph:rank-two-structural-consequence
rows.statement: Compose the two-by-two path view and retain the full Frobenius attribution view.

rows.label: subsec:graph:three-interfaces
rows.statement: Track three interfaces as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:dual-view-architecture
rows.statement: Expose scalar, path-view and attribution-view extractions separately.

rows.label: tbl:graph:computational-interfaces
rows.statement: Keep raw geometry consumers separate from complete-act standing compilation.

rows.label: subsec:graph:path-view-and-signed-svd
rows.statement: Track path view and signed svd as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:path-view-extraction
rows.statement: Extract the softened bilinear block with Full, Half and Marginal routing floors.

rows.label: eq:graph:path-view-extraction
rows.statement: Extract the softened bilinear block with Full, Half and Marginal routing floors.

rows.label: case:graph:path-view-extraction-full-or-minimal
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:path-view-extraction``: For full or marginal tiers, soften each binary mask entry a to a+(1-a) times the bleed parameter when extracting the path view.

rows.label: case:graph:path-view-extraction-half-corner
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:path-view-extraction``: For the half tier, keep the path-view polarization corner (1,1) at coefficient one.

rows.label: case:graph:path-view-extraction-half-off-corner
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:path-view-extraction``: For the half tier, set the three off-corner path-view coefficients to the half floor; keep the full stored slice, attribution Frobenius norm and CAN base values unchanged.

rows.label: def:graph:signed-svd
rows.statement: Decompose nonsingular two-by-two matrices into proper rotations, singular magnitudes and orientation.

rows.label: eq:graph:signed-svd
rows.statement: Decompose nonsingular two-by-two matrices into proper rotations, singular magnitudes and orientation.

rows.label: lem:graph:signed-svd-uniqueness
rows.statement: Distinct singular values determine the dominant axis up to simultaneous rotation sign.

rows.label: case:graph:signed-svd-uniqueness-distinct-singular-values
rows.statement: Branch of ``lem:graph:signed-svd-uniqueness`` proof: For distinct singular values in the signed SO(2) decomposition, the only residual ambiguity is simultaneous negation of both rotations; the dominant axis line is invariant.

rows.label: case:graph:signed-svd-uniqueness-isotropic
rows.statement: Branch of ``lem:graph:signed-svd-uniqueness`` proof: For equal singular values, the residual expands to a continuous family; the dominant axis is undefined and its angle is not assigned.

rows.label: def:graph:coherence-ratio
rows.statement: Return the singular-value ratio and handle the isotropic endpoint explicitly.

rows.label: def:graph:dominant-mode-angle
rows.statement: Compute the acute dominant-axis angle only when that axis is defined.

rows.label: eq:graph:dominant-mode-angle
rows.statement: Compute the acute dominant-axis angle only when that axis is defined.

rows.label: rem:graph:signed-svd-geometric-mean
rows.statement: At half diversity use the determinant magnitude while signed consumers retain parity.

rows.label: rem:graph:score-exponent-uniqueness
rows.statement: Keep the stated determinant square-root exponent distinct from freely tunable terminal rendering.

rows.label: rem:graph:trace-determinant-recovery
rows.statement: Recover determinant from signed singular values and trace only with the relative rotation.

rows.label: eq:graph:trace-recovery
rows.statement: Recover determinant from signed singular values and trace only with the relative rotation.

rows.label: eq:graph:det-recovery
rows.statement: Recover determinant from signed singular values and trace only with the relative rotation.

rows.label: subsec:graph:determinant-sign-and-tiers
rows.statement: Track determinant sign and tiers as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:determinant-sign
rows.statement: Extract orientation only for nonzero determinant.

rows.label: eq:graph:determinant-sign
rows.statement: Extract orientation only for nonzero determinant.

rows.label: rem:graph:one-bit-extraction-cost
rows.statement: Parity extraction reuses the determinant already computed for raw magnitude.

rows.label: prop:graph:pipeline-anisotropy
rows.statement: Canonical nonzero-parameter path views have distinct singular values.

rows.label: rem:graph:zero-parameter-degeneracy
rows.statement: Zero-parameter edges are routing-inert with undefined parity but may still anchor title.

rows.label: prop:graph:path-view-determinant-bound
rows.statement: Check nonvanishing determinants and tier-dependent reference bounds without imposing reference bands as universal caps.

rows.label: case:graph:path-view-determinant-bound-full-mask
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:graph:path-view-determinant-bound`` proof: For the full path-view mask, all four entries are unsoftened and the determinant is ad-bc; the reference parameters give the stated determinant and square-root magnitude.

rows.label: case:graph:path-view-determinant-bound-epistemic-mask
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:graph:path-view-determinant-bound`` proof: For the Epistemic path-view mask, softening the first column gives determinant bleed times (ad-bc); the reference parameters give the stated determinant and square-root score.

rows.label: case:graph:path-view-determinant-bound-economic-mask
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:graph:path-view-determinant-bound`` proof: For the Economic path-view mask, softening the first row gives determinant bleed times (ad-bc), with square-root score of order sqrt(bleed).

rows.label: case:graph:path-view-determinant-bound-identity-mask
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:graph:path-view-determinant-bound`` proof: For the Identity path-view mask, softening both off-diagonal entries gives determinant ad minus bleed squared times bc. The reference Self score is above the non-Self full-mask band and consistent with the full-tier assignment.

rows.label: case:graph:path-view-determinant-bound-minimal-mask
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:graph:path-view-determinant-bound`` proof: For the Minimal path-view mask, soften all but the polarization corner, giving determinant bleed times (ad-bleed times bc). The stated lower-bound estimate is strictly positive when the signed core magnitude exceeds twice bleed; small-parameter scores approach zero.

rows.label: case:graph:path-view-determinant-bound-half-tier
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:graph:path-view-determinant-bound`` proof: For a half-tier full block, attenuating the three off-corner entries gives determinant half-floor times (ad-half-floor times bc), of order half-floor; the reference Accept and Bid parameters give the stated scores.

rows.label: lem:graph:tier-floor-sign-invariance
rows.statement: Half-tier attenuation preserves the full-block determinant sign.

rows.label: lem:graph:quadrant-law
rows.statement: Parity equals the semantic-parameter product sign and survives a joint sign flip.

rows.label: rem:graph:sign-semantics
rows.statement: Do not substitute coherence parity for positive semantic stance in standing eligibility.

rows.label: subsec:graph:augmented-tensor
rows.statement: Track augmented tensor as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:augmented-tensor
rows.statement: Form temporal augmentation with the Frobenius factorization.

rows.label: eq:graph:augmented-tensor
rows.statement: Form temporal augmentation with the Frobenius factorization.

rows.label: thm:graph:maturity-amplification
rows.statement: Temporal norm amplification rises from one toward square root two.

rows.label: subsec:graph:path-composition
rows.statement: Track path composition as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:path-matrix
rows.statement: Multiply path-view matrices in the selected raw path order.

rows.label: eq:graph:path-matrix
rows.statement: Multiply path-view matrices in the selected raw path order.

rows.label: prop:graph:polarization-self-reinforcement
rows.statement: Apply the polarization lower bound only when the cross term is nonnegative.

rows.label: thm:graph:svd-composition-bounds
rows.statement: Check upper and lower singular-value product bounds under composition.

rows.label: thm:graph:determinant-product
rows.statement: Path determinant equals the product of edge determinants.

rows.label: cor:graph:condition-number-submultiplicativity
rows.statement: Bound path condition number by the product of edge condition numbers.

rows.label: rem:graph:order-sensitivity
rows.statement: Distinguish order-sensitive path matrices from order-independent determinant products.

rows.label: lem:graph:ordered-replay-determinism
rows.statement: The same ordered history and constants reproduce all declared graph readings.

rows.label: cor:graph:path-parity-sign
rows.statement: Compose path parity by multiplying edge orientation signs.

rows.label: eq:graph:path-parity-sign
rows.statement: Compose path parity by multiplying edge orientation signs.

rows.label: def:graph:svd-path-score
rows.statement: Compute the two-singular-value diversity score with maturity and boundary damping.

rows.label: eq:graph:svd-path-score
rows.statement: Compute the two-singular-value diversity score with maturity and boundary damping.

rows.label: eq:graph:half-score
rows.statement: Compute the two-singular-value diversity score with maturity and boundary damping.

rows.label: rem:graph:diversity-preference-default
rows.statement: The half-diversity default yields scalar determinant factorization.

rows.label: case:graph:diversity-preference-default-dominant-mode
rows.statement: At diversity preference zero, score the strongest singular mode, favoring dominant alignment.

rows.label: case:graph:diversity-preference-default-balanced
rows.statement: At the default diversity preference one half, use the geometric-mean score sqrt(abs(det)); compute a determinant and sign per edge and reserve richer signed-SVD quantities for post-ranking presentation.

rows.label: case:graph:diversity-preference-default-weakest-mode
rows.statement: At diversity preference one, score the weakest singular mode, favoring diversity preservation.

rows.label: tbl:graph:extraction-tiering
rows.statement: Compute determinant scalars per edge and reserve richer diagnostics for declared consumers.

rows.label: def:graph:path-distance
rows.statement: Minimize raw reciprocal determinant-maturity costs without boundary damping.

rows.label: eq:graph:path-distance
rows.statement: Minimize raw reciprocal determinant-maturity costs without boundary damping.

rows.label: subsec:graph:structural-properties
rows.statement: Track structural properties as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: lem:graph:non-vanishing-norm
rows.statement: The always-active baseline gives a positive slice norm floor.

rows.label: lem:graph:frobenius-bound
rows.statement: Bound the nine-entry slice Frobenius norm by three.

rows.label: prop:graph:polarization-floor
rows.statement: Preserve baseline and polarization floors across canonical masks.

rows.label: rem:graph:path-shortening-tendency
rows.statement: The stated path-shortening tendency is conditional on the sign of the cross term.

rows.label: def:graph:anisotropy-penalty
rows.statement: Compute the analytical SVD-versus-Frobenius log-cost diagnostic without using it as a routing input.

rows.label: eq:graph:anisotropy-penalty
rows.statement: Compute the analytical SVD-versus-Frobenius log-cost diagnostic without using it as a routing input.

rows.label: prop:graph:svd-score-properties
rows.statement: Check stated strength, diversity and weak-link score properties within their declared domains.

rows.label: prop:graph:coherence-decay-bound
rows.statement: Bound path coherence decay by the geometric mean of edge condition numbers.

rows.label: thm:graph:frobenius-upper-bound
rows.statement: Bound the dominant singular value by path Frobenius norm and edge norm products.

rows.label: subsec:graph:path-diagnostics-and-archetypes
rows.statement: Track path diagnostics and archetypes as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: rem:graph:path-frame-convention
rows.statement: Interpret path diagnostics in the first edge intensity frame.

rows.label: tbl:graph:sentiment-archetypes
rows.statement: Terminal archetype presentation does not alter scoring.

rows.label: subsec:graph:aggregation-and-hyper-edges
rows.statement: Track aggregation and hyper edges as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:aggregated-sentiment
rows.statement: Compute declared incoming sentiment means for the terminal content scalar.

rows.label: def:graph:hyper-edge-scalar-interface
rows.statement: Use the product of matched raw-leg norms as a raw consistency identity, never a standing coefficient.

rows.label: thm:graph:hyper-edge-reduction
rows.statement: Keep raw scalar, path-view, attribution and complete-act standing reductions distinct.

rows.label: itm:graph:hyper-edge-reduction-raw-scalar
rows.statement: For a complete hyper-edge act, compute its raw scalar norm as the product of its two leg norms.

rows.label: itm:graph:hyper-edge-reduction-raw-path
rows.statement: For a complete hyper-edge, multiply the two raw path-view matrices in leg order; its determinant and parity are the products of the leg determinants and parities.

rows.label: itm:graph:hyper-edge-reduction-attribution
rows.statement: For attribution, take each hyper-edge leg as an independent CAN base value and compose them at depth one with redundancy one.

rows.label: itm:graph:hyper-edge-reduction-standing
rows.statement: Consume a hyper-edge once in standing exactly when its family is in the closed person-vouch census and the act is complete. Neither leg is an independent standing edge; forbid unmatched terminal-leg entry or substitution of an unrelated incoming leg, and omit the passive middle artifact from the projected standing path.

rows.label: cor:graph:standing-act-atomicity
rows.statement: Accept a designated complete hyper-act for standing or contribute no outward standing through it.

rows.label: subsec:graph:interaction-domains
rows.statement: Track interaction domains as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: tbl:graph:interaction-domains
rows.statement: Represent domain masks and distinguish defaults from the normative per-family census.

rows.label: def:graph:mask-promotion-criterion
rows.statement: Promote signed target-stance masks according to the census rather than self-report semantics.

rows.label: def:graph:proposal-half-tier
rows.statement: Apply Half routing floors to settlement and conversational proposal families while preserving stored slices.

rows.label: subsec:graph:settlement-lifecycle
rows.statement: Track settlement lifecycle as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:graph:item-genesis-act
rows.statement: Root Item title in its self-minting Owner act; structural identity survives payload removal but does not establish real-world referent identity.

rows.label: rem:graph:item-identity-limit
rows.statement: Treat title as ownership of a registered claim, not proof of a real-world referent.

rows.label: def:graph:settlement-act-reference
rows.statement: Accept and Ratify name the Bid act, and Ratify also names the exact Accept.

rows.label: def:graph:act-causal-parents
rows.statement: Retain backward public causal references as immutable metadata without graph incidence.

rows.label: def:graph:dependent-act-set
rows.statement: Close candidate acts under causal ancestors and retain whole hyper-act projections.

rows.label: cor:graph:act-projection-atomicity
rows.statement: Admit both hyper-act projections together without introducing a causal cycle.

rows.label: rem:graph:dependency-closure-excludes-conflicts
rows.statement: Do not expand causal dependency closure to concurrent cancellation conflicts.

rows.label: def:graph:public-protocol-reference
rows.statement: Keep formation and settlement references available after every removable projection is tombstoned.

rows.label: def:graph:act-removable-projections
rows.statement: Model content and dependency openings separately over immutable commitment residues.

rows.label: def:graph:act-dependency-projection
rows.statement: Encode a bounded versioned sorted unique act-identifier set with explicit empty and tombstoned states.

rows.label: case:graph:act-dependency-projection-full-empty
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:act-dependency-projection``: A full-empty dependency projection contains the canonical empty dependency list and its opening; distinguish it from a missing or tombstoned list.

rows.label: case:graph:act-dependency-projection-full
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:act-dependency-projection``: A full dependency projection carries its canonical list and opening, bound to the act; carriage may move one-way toward tombstoned.

rows.label: case:graph:act-dependency-projection-tombstoned
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:graph:act-dependency-projection``: A tombstoned dependency projection removes the list and opening from Layer-1 carriage but retains the binding commitment residue that a later opening must reopen.

rows.label: def:graph:act-dependency-tombstone
rows.statement: Remove dependency carriage without deleting or recomputing finalized structural history.

rows.label: rem:graph:authentication-realization-out-of-scope
rows.statement: Leave cryptographic algorithms, key management and wire realization to explicit deployment decisions.

rows.label: def:graph:proposal-pre-commitment
rows.statement: Bind the actor proposal and requested projection states before host salts or ordering.

rows.label: def:graph:verified-act
rows.statement: Represent the validated host-sealed header with separate commitment editions and no order fields.

rows.label: def:graph:approval-witness
rows.statement: Only the exact actor-approved verified act is eligible for candidate ordering.

rows.label: def:graph:ordering-fraud-proof
rows.statement: An ordinary full dependency opening can demonstrate a finalized ordering violation.

rows.label: post:graph:ordering-accountability
rows.statement: A successful ordering fraud proof attributes fault without rewriting final history.

rows.label: post:graph:act-authentication-requirements
rows.statement: Require authorship, integrity, visible host additions, exact approval, hyper-act unity and retained binding.

rows.label: itm:graph:act-authentication-requirements-authorship
rows.statement: Before authoritative-sequence eligibility, require publicly checkable evidence that the named Actor authorized the proposal.

rows.label: itm:graph:act-authentication-requirements-proposal-integrity
rows.statement: Make host substitution of the proposal’s structural body, removable payload projection, dependency projection or requested publication state detectable before authoritative-sequence eligibility.

rows.label: itm:graph:act-authentication-requirements-transparency
rows.statement: Show the Actor every host-added field of the finalizable act before final approval.

rows.label: itm:graph:act-authentication-requirements-approval
rows.statement: Admit to the authoritative sequence only the exact finalizable act the Actor approved.

rows.label: itm:graph:act-authentication-requirements-unity
rows.statement: Require both hyper-edge projections to resolve to the same approved parent act.

rows.label: itm:graph:act-authentication-requirements-projection-binding
rows.statement: Removing a projection opening must not allow the immutable act to be rebound to a different payload or dependency value.

rows.label: itm:graph:act-authentication-requirements-ordering
rows.statement: Where dependency compliance is claimed, retain public evidence that can establish a violation without changing finalized history.

rows.label: def:graph:act-finalization-epoch
rows.statement: Identify the first accepted epoch of an act and compare title events at that granularity.

rows.label: def:graph:act-envelope
rows.statement: Publish the accepted act identifier, author, family, body, protocol references, causal parents, commitments, handshake, approval witness, finalization epoch and act time as an abstract envelope, with payload bytes, salts and dependency opening beside it and serialization left to deployment.

rows.label: def:graph:settlement-recognition
rows.statement: Check the six recognition clauses including prior ownership and co-epoch cancellation precedence.

rows.label: itm:graph:settlement-recognition-completeness
rows.statement: Recognize a settlement candidate only if its Bid, Accept and Ratify acts are present with their edge projections in the final epoch edge set.

rows.label: itm:graph:settlement-recognition-reference-binding
rows.statement: Require both Accept and Ratify settlement references to resolve to the identifier of the Bid act that opened the Offer.

rows.label: itm:graph:settlement-recognition-authorization
rows.statement: Require the Accept author to be the certified owner at the boundary immediately before the Ratify’s finalization epoch, using the genesis owner for a fresh thread.

rows.label: itm:graph:settlement-recognition-buyer-consent
rows.statement: Refuse settlement recognition if a buyer Withdraw on the Offer finalizes no later than the Ratify’s epoch; a same-epoch cancellation defeats consent.

rows.label: itm:graph:settlement-recognition-seller-consent
rows.statement: Refuse settlement recognition if a seller Rescind on the Offer finalizes no later than the Ratify’s epoch; a same-epoch cancellation defeats consent.

rows.label: itm:graph:settlement-recognition-well-formedness
rows.statement: Check the observed handshake order Bid before Accept before Ratify as well-formedness only; it provides no tie breaker.

rows.label: rem:graph:title-order-irrelevance
rows.statement: Title uses epoch membership and reference-forced handshake order rather than host tie-breaking.

rows.label: post:graph:boundary-accountability
rows.statement: Publish partition, constraints, closure cause and timestamp while granting no inclusion rights.

rows.label: rem:graph:settlement-clause-structure
rows.statement: Recognition reads membership, pointers, prior title and epoch indices without audit positions.

rows.label: def:graph:ownership-thread
rows.statement: Follow boundary transfers from genesis and distinguish failed claims from ordinary description updates.

rows.label: def:graph:settlement-consumption
rows.statement: Consume every recognized unchallenged co-epoch candidate permanently even when conflicts prevent transfer.

rows.label: def:graph:title-certificate
rows.statement: Map each Item to its thread terminal owner or void.

rows.label: thm:graph:epoch-title-fold
rows.statement: Transfer on one candidate, retain incumbent on zero or multiple candidates, and consume conflicts.

rows.label: rem:graph:regret-window
rows.statement: Treat the boundary certificate as finality and keep cancellation subject to inclusion.

rows.label: rem:graph:cancellation-best-effort
rows.statement: Cancellation wins an admitted co-epoch tie but has no guaranteed delivery.

rows.label: thm:graph:settlement-order-freeness
rows.statement: Preserve title under residual sub-epoch permutations of a fixed epoch partition.

rows.label: thm:graph:no-death-by-inaction
rows.statement: Require authored settlement transitions rather than per-object expiry.

rows.label: rem:graph:causal-locality-principle
rows.statement: Permit global progress gates but no settlement state change triggered by its own inactivity.

rows.label: rem:graph:settlement-reputation
rows.statement: Standing reads complete folded acts.
