Accept and Ratify allocate outward only with positive mandatory folded coordinates and recognized, unchallenged, title-transferring candidates; otherwise they resolve to self while remaining weighed, priced and counted. Raw parity remains recognition-blind and proves no external assertion.

rows.label: rem:graph:reviews-commentary
rows.statement: Reviews do not change title and resolve their standing allocation home.

rows.label: rem:graph:settlement-cross-layer
rows.statement: Publish a deterministic title commit anchor without promising custody or payment atomicity.

rows.label: alg:graph:title-certificate-computation
rows.statement: Replay epoch partitions to compute title with single-candidate transfer and conflict consumption.

rows.label: subsec:graph:consumer-map
rows.statement: Track consumer map as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: tbl:graph:consumer-map
rows.statement: Route each geometry output only to its named consumer and keep raw legs out of standing compilation.

rows.label: sec:nodes
rows.statement: Track nodes as a separately addressable section.

rows.label: subsec:nodes:universal-principles
rows.statement: Enforce act authorship, shared time, tensor roles, complete hyper-acts, opaque payloads and census-only allocation.

rows.label: post:nodes:canonical-tensor-pipeline
rows.statement: Assign parameter roles, form the masked slice, soften the path view and extract temporal and attribution interfaces.

rows.label: step:nodes:canonical-tensor-pipeline-role-assignment
rows.statement: For every binary edge or hyper-edge leg, assign the domain parameters to directional and intensity roles; for a single-parameter edge set the missing role to one.

rows.label: step:nodes:canonical-tensor-pipeline-extended-slice
rows.statement: Compute each extended tensor slice with the master sentiment-slice formula and its domain bilinear mask.

rows.label: step:nodes:canonical-tensor-pipeline-path-view
rows.statement: Extract the path view from each extended slice using the declared bleed softening.

rows.label: step:nodes:canonical-tensor-pipeline-temporal-augmentation
rows.statement: Augment the extended slice by its outer product with the temporal vector (1, tau).

rows.label: step:nodes:canonical-tensor-pipeline-interface-extraction
rows.statement: Expose the scalar interface as the extended slice Frobenius norm times sqrt(1+tau squared), the path interface as the extracted path view, and the attribution interface as the unaugmented Frobenius norm.

rows.label: rem:nodes:row-collapse
rows.statement: Type-fixed missing parameters equal one and cannot be user-selected to exploit row duplication.

rows.label: subsec:nodes:standing-recipient-resolution
rows.statement: Weigh all accepted acts once and route non-person activity into self-retention.

rows.label: rem:nodes:coherence-does-not-allocate
rows.statement: Positive raw parity never substitutes for complete eligible positive-coordinate acts.

rows.label: subsec:nodes:affordance-traits
rows.statement: Enforce class-syntactic target typing, allow ordinary updates and require Bid to mint a fresh Offer.

rows.label: tbl:nodes:affordance-traits
rows.statement: Assign Taggable, Reviewable, Ownable and Conversational capabilities to the declared passive types.

rows.label: subsec:nodes:active-node
rows.statement: Track active node as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: node:nodes:actor
rows.statement: Actor is the sole active author type with a grounded burn address.

rows.label: eq:nodes:connectivity:actor
rows.statement: Enforce the declared incoming and outgoing projection families for actor identifiers.

rows.label: rem:nodes:anchoring-and-relational-support
rows.statement: Assign standing only to anchored actors and never manufacture source with the activation clamp.

rows.label: subsec:nodes:leaf-passive-nodes
rows.statement: Track leaf passive nodes as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: node:nodes:profile
rows.statement: Profile is the unique passive grounded partner of an Actor and identifies a person-directed target.

rows.label: eq:nodes:connectivity:profile
rows.statement: Enforce the declared incoming and outgoing projection families for profile identifiers.

rows.label: node:nodes:content
rows.statement: Content is a minted Taggable and Reviewable artifact with Publish genesis.

rows.label: eq:nodes:connectivity:content
rows.statement: Enforce the declared incoming and outgoing projection families for content identifiers.

rows.label: node:nodes:item
rows.statement: Item is a minted Ownable artifact whose title is a boundary fold.

rows.label: eq:nodes:connectivity:item
rows.statement: Enforce the declared incoming and outgoing projection families for item identifiers.

rows.label: node:nodes:type
rows.statement: Type is an exact-name public semantic anchor with no owner.

rows.label: eq:nodes:connectivity:type
rows.statement: Enforce the declared incoming and outgoing projection families for type identifiers.

rows.label: node:nodes:chat
rows.statement: Chat is a minted conversational artifact established by founding Participant.

rows.label: eq:nodes:connectivity:chat
rows.statement: Enforce the declared incoming and outgoing projection families for chat identifiers.

rows.label: subsec:nodes:hyper-leaf-passive-nodes
rows.statement: Track hyper leaf passive nodes as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: node:nodes:comment
rows.statement: Comment is the contextual minted target of Review and remains Taggable and Reviewable.

rows.label: eq:nodes:connectivity:comment
rows.statement: Enforce the declared incoming and outgoing projection families for comment identifiers.

rows.label: rem:nodes:nested-comment-review
rows.statement: Allow authored Review chains over Comments without conferring passive authorship.

rows.label: node:nodes:message
rows.statement: Message is the minted Send target within Chat context.

rows.label: eq:nodes:connectivity:message
rows.statement: Enforce the declared incoming and outgoing projection families for message identifiers.

rows.label: node:nodes:offer
rows.statement: Offer is a fresh Bid target with settlement references distinct from incidence.

rows.label: eq:nodes:connectivity:offer
rows.statement: Enforce the declared incoming and outgoing projection families for offer identifiers.

rows.label: subsec:nodes:binary-edges
rows.statement: Track binary edges as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: eq:nodes:self-edge-bond-stored
rows.statement: Construct the shared Identity-mask Self slice.

rows.label: eq:nodes:self-edge-bond-pathview
rows.statement: Construct the shared softened Self path view.

rows.label: eq:nodes:self-edge-bond-det
rows.statement: Evaluate the Self determinant from the bond kernel.

rows.label: eq:nodes:self-edge-bond-detscore
rows.statement: Evaluate the positive Self determinant square root.

rows.label: eq:nodes:self-edge-bond-parities
rows.statement: Both nonzero-standing Self components have positive parity.

rows.label: eq:nodes:self-edge-bond-dampedweight
rows.statement: Apply raw maturity and entropy damping to the Self determinant score.

rows.label: edge:nodes:self-declaration
rows.statement: Derive Actor-to-Profile Declaration from current standing without an authored act.

rows.label: edge:nodes:self-reputation
rows.statement: Derive Profile-to-Actor Reputation for raw traversal and exclude it from standing and CAN leaves.

rows.label: edge:nodes:registration
rows.statement: Represent fixed-parameter Actor-to-Profile anchoring and priced parallel payload updates.

rows.label: edge:nodes:publish
rows.statement: Represent signed attachment to Content with self-minting genesis or ordinary update roles.

rows.label: def:nodes:profile-bridged-discovery-path
rows.statement: Expose the terminal Opinion-Reputation-Opinion raw path without using it for standing.

rows.label: eq:nodes:profile-bridged-weight
rows.statement: Multiply the three raw profile-bridge edge weights.

rows.label: def:nodes:raw-profile-bridge-amplification
rows.statement: Combine raw Reputation weight with dimensionless creator amplification.

rows.label: eq:nodes:commitment-amplification-product
rows.statement: Multiply raw Reputation weight by reduced-standing amplification.

rows.label: edge:nodes:opinion
rows.statement: Represent Tribal polarity and reaction toward a passive target with Profile-only person eligibility.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:opinion
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for opinion.

rows.label: edge:nodes:affinity
rows.statement: Represent unpromoted association and attraction toward Type.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:affinity
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for affinity.

rows.label: edge:nodes:participant
rows.statement: Represent one two-leg Chat movement act with mandatory A coordinates and a fixed-positive T intensity.

rows.label: case:nodes:participant-found
rows.statement: Branch of ``edge:nodes:participant``: A founding Participant uses mint of its own act identifier for both the A-leg origin and T-leg destination, creating the Chat through its terminal target.

rows.label: case:nodes:participant-join
rows.statement: Branch of ``edge:nodes:participant``: A joining Participant names the same existing Chat as A-leg origin and T-leg destination; it mints nothing.

rows.label: case:nodes:participant-found-successor
rows.statement: Branch of ``edge:nodes:participant``: A Participant founding a successor names the old Chat as A-leg origin and its own minted Chat as T-leg destination.

rows.label: case:nodes:participant-move
rows.statement: Branch of ``edge:nodes:participant``: A moving Participant names the origin Chat on the A-leg and destination Chat on the T-leg. Formation does not check prior membership in the origin; without it the act is a decorated join, and the fold reads leg roles rather than trusting the origin claim.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:participant
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for participant.

rows.label: lem:nodes:self-loop-neutral
rows.statement: A positive-parity subunit-weight self-loop cannot improve a raw max-product result.

rows.label: case:nodes:self-loop-neutral-routing-inert
rows.statement: Branch of ``lem:nodes:self-loop-neutral`` proof: A zero-determinant self-loop is routing-inert and excluded from canonical raw traversal, so it cannot improve either parity register.

rows.label: case:nodes:self-loop-neutral-routing-active
rows.statement: Branch of ``lem:nodes:self-loop-neutral`` proof: A routing-active positive-parity self-loop has weight strictly below one; removing it preserves parity and improves and shortens the walk, so it cannot improve a max-product register or additive log-cost optimum.

rows.label: rem:nodes:self-loop-parity
rows.statement: Keep Participant terminal-leg parity positive to prevent a shared parity-flipping device.

rows.label: edge:nodes:owner
rows.statement: Represent signed Item attachment while reserving title genesis to self-minting acts.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:owner
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for owner.

rows.label: edge:nodes:join-request
rows.statement: Represent a Half-tier Chat proposal that does not create membership or outward standing.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:join-request
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for join-request.

rows.label: edge:nodes:accept
rows.statement: Represent seller comfort and equity with the exact Bid reference and defer standing/title interpretation.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:accept
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for accept.

rows.label: edge:nodes:ratify
rows.statement: Represent buyer confirmation with Bid and exact Accept references, finalized only at a boundary.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:ratify
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for ratify.

rows.label: edge:nodes:withdraw
rows.statement: Represent buyer cancellation toward an Offer as a fixed-parameter control act.

rows.label: edge:nodes:rescind
rows.statement: Represent seller cancellation toward an Offer with co-epoch recognition consequences.

rows.label: edge:nodes:leave
rows.statement: Represent unconditional priced departure without a membership prerequisite.

rows.label: subsec:nodes:hyper-edges
rows.statement: Track hyper edges as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: edge:nodes:hyper-tag
rows.statement: Represent one role-swapped relevance/confidence act joining an actor, Taggable artifact and Type.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:tag-l1
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for tag-l1.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:tag-l2
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for tag-l2.

rows.label: edge:nodes:hyper-review
rows.statement: Represent one enthusiasm/effort commentary act with Tribal A and Epistemic T projections.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:review-l1
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for review-l1.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:review-l2
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for review-l2.

rows.label: edge:nodes:hyper-bid
rows.statement: Represent one signed-generosity and urgency act that creates an Offer with two Half-tier projections.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:bid-l1
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for bid-l1.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:bid-l2
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for bid-l2.

rows.label: cor:nodes:bid-leg-parity
rows.statement: Nondegenerate Bid legs have matching signs and positive composed parity while zero coordinates are inert.

rows.label: edge:nodes:hyper-invitation
rows.statement: Represent one inviter-owned act through Chat to the invitee Profile with complete-act positive-coordinate eligibility.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:invitation-l1
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for invitation-l1.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:invitation-l2
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for invitation-l2.

rows.label: edge:nodes:hyper-deinvite
rows.statement: Represent unconditional control toward Chat and Profile with author-specific invitation suppression.

rows.label: edge:nodes:hyper-reference
rows.statement: Represent a nonminting artifact-context citation with Epistemic A and Tribal T projections.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:reference-l1
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for reference-l1.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:reference-l2
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for reference-l2.

rows.label: rem:nodes:reference-author-allocation
rows.statement: Only allocation through the Reference author reaches its complete positive Profile-targeted act.

rows.label: rem:nodes:departure-composes-with-opinion
rows.statement: Keep control-family parameters fixed and express additional sentiment in a separate Opinion.

rows.label: rem:nodes:chat-proposals-do-not-participate
rows.statement: Invitations may allocate through their author but proposals never create participation.

rows.label: def:nodes:canonical-membership-fold
rows.statement: Terminal membership reads act leg roles and latest participation/departure under published guild policy.

rows.label: rem:nodes:membership-is-terminal
rows.statement: Do not place membership predicates in Layer 1 admission.

rows.label: rem:nodes:membership-not-chain-ordered
rows.statement: The canonical terminal membership fold intentionally retains host-order sensitivity.

rows.label: edge:nodes:hyper-send
rows.statement: Represent one signed-importance Message act with Full A and Minimal T projections.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:send-a
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for send-a.

rows.label: eq:nodes:path-view:send-t
rows.statement: Compute the declared role-specific path-view matrix for send-t.

rows.label: prop:nodes:self-loop-neutral
rows.statement: The derived Declaration/Reputation loop cannot improve either raw register.

rows.label: step:nodes:self-loop-neutral-max-product
rows.statement: For raw snapshot traversal, the Declaration/Reputation loop multiplies a register by a product strictly below one, so max-product relaxation cannot improve the source or any mid-path register. Standing does not traverse this loop.

rows.label: step:nodes:self-loop-neutral-parity
rows.statement: The raw Declaration/Reputation loop has positive parity on both edges and maps the initialized positive/negative pair (1,0) to a smaller positive value with zero negative value. Neutrality follows from weight and parity, not a claim that causal order blocks the loop.

rows.label: prop:nodes:raw-self-edge-properties
rows.statement: Check raw Self zero-source, parity, synchronization and weight properties separately from standing activation.

rows.label: itm:nodes:raw-self-edge-properties-zero
rows.statement: At zero standing, require zero raw self-edge activation and damped Reputation weight, so the bond is inert.

rows.label: itm:nodes:raw-self-edge-properties-monotonicity
rows.statement: At fixed raw maturity, require the damped Reputation weight to increase strictly with positive standing. This is an input derivative of the raw edge, not a burn-response guarantee.

rows.label: itm:nodes:raw-self-edge-properties-bound
rows.statement: Keep the raw damped Reputation weight strictly below one for every nonnegative standing and permitted maturity.

rows.label: itm:nodes:raw-self-edge-properties-concavity
rows.statement: At fixed raw maturity, require the damped Reputation weight to be strictly concave in positive standing.

rows.label: itm:nodes:raw-self-edge-properties-parity
rows.statement: Require positive Declaration and Reputation determinant parity at every positive standing.

rows.label: itm:nodes:raw-self-edge-properties-synchronization
rows.statement: At every epoch boundary, derive Declaration and Reputation with identical stored tensors, determinant scores and damped-weight formulas.

rows.label: itm:nodes:raw-self-edge-properties-can-independence
rows.statement: Treat normalized CAN as independent of an Actor’s standing only when its Declaration is outside its own composition dependency closure; Reputation contributes nothing to CAN.

rows.label: itm:epoch:rival-allocation-response-wall-flatness

The capacity ceiling coexists with the concentration allowed under the receiving premises of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration``.

rows.label: rem:epoch:source-emission-rationale

Publish fading and sag experience; a time-decay sink or relocated mass requires a charter amendment and a new cluster-identity argument. Partition capacity is bounded without fixing actual export or standing. Changed-history displacement has the scoped pair and concentration bounds of ``prop:epoch:split-pair-displacement`` and ``prop:epoch:split-concentration``.

rows.label: def:epoch:finite-depth-conserved-transport

rows.label: eq:epoch:finite-depth-conserved-transport
rows.statement: Mix ordered hop-matrix products and add nonemitted mass to the diagonal.

rows.label: rem:epoch:transport-is-not-ledger-transfer

Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: rem:epoch:emission-self-inertia

Burn raises own source rate and emission until saturation, not necessarily final standing; rehabilitation requires the stated response tests or a certified finite comparison.

rows.label: cor:epoch:conserving-emission

rows.label: thm:epoch:emission-export-bound

rows.label: eq:epoch:emission-export-bound

A fixed-pair partition cannot enlarge the aggregate ceiling, while actual export and standing can change; no universal small displacement follows. The capacity ceiling coexists with the concentration allowed under the receiving premises of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration``.

rows.label: rem:epoch:emission-wall-symmetry
rows.statement: Distinguish own-source emission from relational safety; publish conditional controller-response evidence without deriving an inter-epoch tracking theorem from an in-epoch certificate.

rows.label: prop:epoch:artifact-non-allocation

rows.statement: Compute final reduced standing and multiply by the numeraire for full standing.

A fixed-pair partition cannot enlarge the aggregate capacity ceiling, although actual export and target standing may change. The capacity ceiling coexists with the concentration allowed under the receiving premises of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration``.

rows.label: prop:epoch:final-standing-hull

The same concentration record can describe a legitimately separate role under ``ex:epoch:split-showcase``; its magnitude does not reveal purpose.

rows.label: prop:epoch:equal-rate-standing-invariance
rows.statement: Equal contributing rates give that exact standing; heterogeneous partitions do not inherit this invariant. The receiving-family concentration of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration`` remains compatible with these scoped invariants.

rows.label: prop:epoch:no-tilt-anchor

rows.label: thm:epoch:closed-cluster-rate-identity
rows.statement: Check the conserved pooled-rate identity for a closed cluster.

rows.label: eq:epoch:closed-cluster-rate-identity
rows.statement: Check the conserved pooled-rate identity for a closed cluster.

rows.label: eq:epoch:closed-cluster-mean
rows.statement: For a two-sided closed cluster, the transported-count-weighted mean standing equals total residual balance divided by total action count. Fixed-count burn raises its reduced mean by the burn increment divided by numeraire times total count; an additional act changes both debit and count. This gives no individual, unweighted-mean or reward direction. The receiving-family concentration of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration`` remains compatible with these scoped invariants.

rows.label: cor:epoch:conserving-source-root-criterion
rows.statement: Check cluster support closure for the pooled-rate identity.

rows.label: cor:epoch:cluster-rate-leakage
rows.statement: Bound departure from the closed-cluster identity under the stated leakage premise. The error scales with boundary-flow weight times rate width; this weighted-mean estimate determines no individual burn-response sign. The receiving-family concentration of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration`` remains compatible with these scoped invariants.

rows.label: def:epoch:actor-partition-comparison
rows.statement: Declare matched complete histories, participant fibre, pair partition, fixed wall/numeraire/policy and recipient/title premises; each history selects its greatest passing rung. This is an explicit counterfactual, not reassignment or inferred common ownership. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: prop:epoch:split-pair-displacement
rows.statement: Check centred pair displacement over the new positive denominator and its common-source rate-width times total-variation bound; changed counts alone do not determine movement. The receiving regime admits the refinement of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration``.

rows.label: prop:epoch:split-exact-invariants
rows.statement: Preserve transported pair totals, the closed transported-count-weighted mean and equal-rate coordinates under the stated partitions; individual coordinates, unweighted sums and maxima need not agree. The receiving-family concentration of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration`` remains compatible with these scoped invariants.

rows.label: prop:epoch:split-fibre-capacity
rows.statement: Bound actual external export by the summed member capacities, no larger than the old capacity. Proportional partition preserves the ceiling, not actual export. The self-path ceiling in ``prop:epoch:split-self-path-export`` refines this capacity bound without turning it into a global advantage optimum.

rows.label: prop:epoch:split-self-path-export
rows.statement: Refine fibre export using certified positive diagonal stay-path probabilities over published depth masses; attainment in the absorbing anchor fixture is not global optimality. Sharpness is confined to its stated family; ``prop:epoch:split-fibre-capacity`` controls the general capacity.

rows.label: prop:epoch:split-concentration
rows.statement: Bound participant maximum gain by member displacement and a common hull width; with unchanged incoming support and absorbing equal-rate members, check the exact concentration formula and its conditional continuous envelope. The identical receiving-family record also permits legitimate separation under the hypotheses of ``prop:epoch:split-legitimate-completion`` and ``ex:epoch:split-showcase``.

rows.label: thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence
rows.statement: For two semantic completions with identical public acts, payloads, ledgers, constants and all rule inputs, deterministic outputs coincide and randomized outputs have the same law when conditional randomness does. A record-based remedy imposes the same standing or fixed-context terminal change on legitimate separation and strategic concentration. This compares completions of one record, not pooled and partitioned records.

rows.label: prop:epoch:split-legitimate-completion
rows.statement: In the admitted receiving family, partition N Registrations into n and N-n at equal source rate with 0<n<N; keep independent donors, complete positive Opinions, incoming acts, absorbing participant rows, empty titles and greatest passing rungs. A legitimate completion exists when private roles are assignable independently, payloads make no contradictory aggregate-scope claim, donors can intend the retained role and no extra public identity or purpose attestation intervenes. This is an existence result for that family, not an inference of actual intent or a claim about every strategic history.

rows.label: ex:epoch:split-small
rows.statement: Reproduce the small certified receiving fixture under ``ver:standing:split-receiving`` and its legitimate-completion hypotheses. Its one partitioned public record admits both an endorsed-role separation and strategic concentration. A record-based reduction or consumer exclusion affects both equally, or with the same distribution if randomized; pooled and partitioned standings need not agree.

rows.label: ex:epoch:split-showcase
rows.statement: Reproduce the certified near-hull concentration fixture under ``ver:standing:split-concentration`` and its legitimate-completion hypotheses. The same sparse retained Profile may separate an endorsed role from unrelated maintenance or serve strategic concentration. A record-based remedy imposes the same loss on both completions, or the same loss distribution; near-hull displacement is no evidence of private purpose.

rows.label: prop:epoch:split-registration-cost
rows.statement: Count the additional Registration debit at its writing price; this is not incremental aggregate burn between matched histories, which may be zero. Under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``, a record-based remedy imposes the same change on a legitimate completion with identical public fields, or the same distribution of changes if randomized.

rows.label: prop:epoch:split-centered-invariance
rows.statement: Check all centred residuals at the lifted coarse solution within the refined hull; simultaneous vanishing characterizes invariance at that state, not a structural classification before solving. The all-state criterion of ``thm:dynamics:split-hop-refinement`` has stronger premises than this equilibrium test.

rows.label: prop:epoch:split-admission-clearance
rows.statement: Use matched-author standing bounds and their act-weighted mean to preserve predicates only when clearance exceeds them; separately check formation, solvency and capacity. Existing fixtures demonstrate no verdict flip. The comparisons in ``ver:standing:split-admissibility`` certify both complete histories; they do not infer private purpose.

rows.label: prop:epoch:final-standing-response
rows.statement: With source rates and other transported coefficients fixed, increasing a source’s contribution lifts or dilutes the target according as its rate exceeds or falls below the target’s standing. A complete act or burn changes further inputs and needs the full finite-response comparison.

rows.label: prop:epoch:final-standing-embedding
rows.statement: Embed disconnected subsystems without changing their standing.

rows.label: rem:epoch:author-directed-allocation
rows.statement: Allocate only through the author whose act expresses regard. A relay apportions the original source’s unit, never its own; no passive artifact supplies authority or target veto. Frozen-flow source-rate comparisons give no universal sign for the completed act.

rows.label: prop:epoch:dilution-cost
rows.statement: Charge each dilution act the in-force price: n such acts cost n times that price, and total grip is bounded by spent balance divided by price. Row conservation prevents cross-target copying. Funded partition and coupled burn or act responses remain subject to capacity, shock and hull bounds, not immunity or a universal sign. Changed-history displacement has the scoped pair and concentration bounds of ``prop:epoch:split-pair-displacement`` and ``prop:epoch:split-concentration``.

rows.label: rem:epoch:griefing-resistance
rows.statement: Bound griefing by author-only rows, priced and count-diluting acts, one rival unit per source, and the depleted-source export ceiling. Low-rate support may still dilute without a target veto; even an unreached sibling can decrease through rival feedback, within the stated response bounds.

rows.label: rem:epoch:rate-parking
rows.statement: Do not infer a universal rate-parking prohibition beyond the declared premises.

rows.label: prop:epoch:no-tilt-commitment-monotonicity
rows.statement: At zero tilt with counts, base, threshold and emission fixed, reached coordinates increase under burn and unreached coordinates stay fixed. Changing emission invalidates this premise; positive-tilt reversals are certified.

rows.label: thm:epoch:burn-response
rows.statement: Universal burn monotonicity is false: certified saturated positive-rung burns can lower own, reached or unreached sibling standing; depleted-source emission can lower a recipient at the anchor. Rung switches can decrease standing and accepted acts have no universal direction.

rows.label: prop:epoch:burn-response-bound
rows.statement: At a smooth saturated fixed passing rung, feedback offsets at most two thirds of the largest direct burn forcing, not necessarily of the burner own forcing; preserve the fixed counts, base, wall and numeraire premises.

rows.label: cor:epoch:burn-monotone-regimes
rows.statement: Establish positive response only by the stated direct-forcing versus feedback tests, fixed-emission anchor or sole-source premises. Small-rung thresholds depend on the ledger; finite paths require the premises throughout.

rows.label: prop:epoch:finite-standing-response
rows.statement: Bound two certified completed states on the same Actor set by their full forcing and both hulls; recompute emission, folds and rung for changed acts or burns instead of assuming a direction.

rows.label: subsec:epoch:within-epoch-standing-solver
rows.statement: Track within epoch standing solver as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: subsec:epoch:epoch-boundary
rows.statement: Track epoch boundary as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:epoch:log-position
rows.statement: Use identity-order rank only as an audit coordinate, never for boundary scoring.

rows.label: def:epoch:epoch-act-budget
rows.statement: Count each complete authored act once toward the epoch target.

rows.label: post:epoch:final-act-sequence-closure
rows.statement: Close at the declared duration and capacity conditions and certify the complete dependent-set union.

rows.label: itm:epoch:final-act-sequence-closure-formation
rows.statement: Require the final act union to be formation-valid and each member’s author to pass own-balance solvency and individual safety on that completed state.

rows.label: itm:epoch:final-act-sequence-closure-safety
rows.statement: Require every final-set member’s action stamp to be at least the safety wall.

rows.label: itm:epoch:final-act-sequence-closure-policy
rows.statement: Compute the epoch stamp once over the complete final act union and require it to meet the effective policy floor.

rows.label: post:epoch:final-edge-set
rows.statement: Publish the monotone epoch edge set, causally closed under the dependent-set closure. Bind the common recognized final marker, fixed policy identity and edition, lineage, interpretation, complete accepted sets and evidence to the accepted acts, prior state and writing-epoch debit vintage. The marker policy selects lists or uniquely verifiable public openings, with complete accepted-set recovery and verification against the policy and both acceptance bounds.

rows.label: rem:epoch:shared-burn-snapshot-rationale
rows.statement: A common accepted snapshot prevents closure components from using inconsistent burn observations; older lineage may first contribute at the accepting marker, without a promise of compulsory or timed acceptance or eventual progress. Consistency does not exclude economic timing effects from boundary timing or acceptance selection.

rows.label: def:epoch:raw-self-edge-reading
rows.statement: Derive current Self bonds and tenure from final standing without appending records.

rows.label: eq:epoch:raw-self-edge-reading
rows.statement: Derive current Self bonds and tenure from final standing without appending records.

rows.label: alg:epoch:conserved-standing-computation
rows.statement: Validate, debit, compile, certify, solve, stamp and gate the complete proposed set.

rows.label: alg:epoch:tilt-backoff
rows.statement: Attempt each rung independently and publish all higher-rung verdicts.

rows.label: prop:epoch:epoch-replay-determinism
rows.statement: Reproduce the derivation from the shared verified marker package, accepted acts, prior state, writing-epoch debit, constants, compiler edition and certificate procedure.

rows.label: subsec:epoch:act-debit
rows.statement: Track act debit as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: post:epoch:act-debit
rows.statement: Debit only the writing-epoch threshold once per accepted authored act.

rows.label: prop:epoch:translation-law
rows.statement: Check exact translation at fixed weights and uniform debit history, not arbitrary fixed points.

rows.label: rem:epoch:dense-cluster-fairness
rows.statement: As incoming transported action mass dominates own retained mass, standing approaches the contributing support’s weighted rate; density or headcount alone does not establish that limit. The closed weighted mean does not fix individual coordinates or participant maxima under funded partition. Identical public records cannot distinguish legitimate separation from strategic concentration under ``thm:epoch:split-observational-equivalence``; private purpose is not a record-derived input.

rows.label: rem:epoch:two-action-counts
rows.statement: Separate live solvency inputs from boundary pairs used by standing.

rows.label: subsec:epoch:participation-gates
rows.statement: Track participation gates as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: post:epoch:final-act-sequence-write-rule
rows.statement: Require own solvency, each final safety stamp and the action-weighted door.

rows.label: cond:epoch:write-own-balance-solvency
rows.statement: Require each authored act to pay its debit from its own settled balance.

rows.label: cond:epoch:write-individual-safety
rows.statement: Check every author against the wall on the proposed final-set equilibrium.

rows.label: cond:epoch:write-epoch-admission
rows.statement: Check the act-weighted epoch stamp against the effective floor and enforce capacity, with the empty-epoch case explicit. Partition-stability guarantees require the clearance premises of ``prop:epoch:split-admission-clearance``.

rows.label: rem:epoch:relational-gate-vs-own-export
rows.statement: Keep solvency, own-history emission and relational safety as separate predicates.

rows.label: rem:epoch:admission-statistics-quarantine
rows.statement: Exclude demand-sensitive regime and headroom from unit-side formulas.

rows.label: rem:epoch:consent-exposure
rows.statement: Written-side boundary accountability cannot reveal suppressed candidates; selection and timely inclusion remain boundary-mechanism obligations.

rows.label: tbl:epoch:actor-states
rows.statement: Distinguish active, band, insolvent and frozen participation states.

rows.label: rem:epoch:band-dwell
rows.statement: Reproduce the stated unsupported no-burn wall and door benchmarks.

rows.label: rem:epoch:non-written-dynamic-live
rows.statement: Retain nonwritten actors in current dynamics unless the safety clamp applies.

rows.label: rem:epoch:registration-final-set-admission
rows.statement: Apply ordinary one-act debit, count, standing and gate rules to Registration.

rows.label: cor:epoch:same-epoch-source-hull
rows.statement: A same-epoch cohort whose contributing source rates all lie below the wall cannot vouch itself above it; a closed zero-rate cohort stays at zero without external positive-rate source. The source hull creates no source and supplies no general heterogeneous funded-partition invariance. The receiving-family concentration of ``prop:epoch:split-concentration`` remains compatible with these scoped invariants.

rows.label: cor:epoch:universal-burn-benchmarks
rows.statement: Compute the ``cond:epoch:write-own-balance-solvency``, safety and door burn benchmarks without promising admission.

rows.label: subsec:epoch:floor-governance
rows.statement: Track floor governance as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:epoch:safety-threshold
rows.statement: The reduced wall is primary and the charged price is its numeraire image; certify that charge on its own epoch width, while deployment wall-calibration and controller-performance evidence remain separate duties.

rows.label: cond:epoch:safety-derivability
rows.statement: Derive the next wall from the completed certificate and published constants, then publish its price image.

rows.label: cond:epoch:safety-in-epoch-certification
rows.statement: Certify the greatest procedure-proved rung on the epoch own width; keep failed and indecisive higher attempts distinct.

rows.label: cond:epoch:safety-wall-step-bound
rows.statement: Bound a wall change by the lesser of the positive absolute cap and the relative cap times the previous wall.

rows.label: cond:epoch:safety-wall-hysteresis
rows.statement: Apply a symmetric relative deadband to the floored proposal before the step cap, with no hidden latch.

rows.label: cond:epoch:safety-publication-lead
rows.statement: Publish the next wall and price one boundary ahead without repricing a consummated debit.

rows.label: cond:epoch:safety-controller-publication
rows.statement: Disclose the wall, controller edition and constants, proposal, delivered wall and price beside the rung and width.

rows.label: cond:epoch:safety-numeraire-covariance
rows.statement: Keep the controller blind to the numeraire and preserve reduced inputs under recoinage; distinguish other structural changes.

rows.label: cond:epoch:safety-declared-floor
rows.statement: Certify the actual wall at or above the deployment fixed exact floor, including zero width and an empty domain.

rows.label: cond:epoch:safety-input-quarantine
rows.statement: Read only previous wall, completed width, accepted rung and constants; exclude admission demand and private history.

rows.label: def:epoch:policy-floor
rows.statement: Announce the host floor one boundary ahead and reject values below the led safety floor.

rows.label: eq:epoch:floor-validity
rows.statement: Check the policy floor against the dimensionless safety floor.

rows.label: def:epoch:participation-floor
rows.statement: Take the maximum of policy and safety floors as fault totalization.

rows.label: eq:epoch:effective-floor
rows.statement: Compute the derived maximum floor without treating it as a new dial.

rows.label: def:epoch:safety-wall
rows.statement: Publish the reduced wall with one-boundary lead and derive its price by multiplication by the numeraire.

rows.label: def:epoch:safety-wall-floor
rows.statement: Declare once beside the numeraire either the exact clean-elasticity ridge image or the rational three thirty-sevenths; compare the actual reduced wall against that fixed structural floor.

rows.label: case:epoch:safety-wall-floor-ridge-floor
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:epoch:safety-wall-floor``: The ridge-floor choice is the exact real p-star/(1-p-star) defined by the unique elasticity ridge, not a grid endpoint or rounded root. Declare it publicly before the first epoch and keep the structural declaration fixed unless a public structural change regenerates its evidence.

rows.label: case:epoch:safety-wall-floor-rational-floor
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:epoch:safety-wall-floor``: The alternative floor is the declared exact rational value from the chartered two-element floor set. Publish the choice before the first epoch beside the numeraire; changing it or choosing a third value requires a public structural change with its own evidence, never epoch tuning.

rows.label: cor:epoch:floor-economics
rows.statement: At a wall at or above the positive structural floor, price is at least numeraire times that floor and real capacity per burn unit is at most its reciprocal; apply integer flooring to residual-balance capacity. Full source emission requires rate at or above the delivered wall, not merely the structural floor. Floor attainment is mathematical and imposes no upper bound on every wall.

rows.label: rem:epoch:floor-is-a-landmark
rows.statement: Treat the floor as a structural leverage landmark, not economic suitability; publish both-floor comparisons and declared economic and work criteria.

rows.label: def:epoch:wall-controller
rows.statement: Publish a numeraire-blind memory-one controller of previous wall, completed width and accepted rung; exclude demand, hidden state and width forecasts.

rows.label: def:epoch:canonical-interim-wall-controller
rows.statement: Compute a floored full-strength target, apply the relative deadband, then cap the signed step by absolute and relative bounds; zero width uses the floor target.

rows.label: case:epoch:canonical-interim-wall-controller-zero-width
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:epoch:canonical-interim-wall-controller``: At zero completed-epoch width, propose the declared structural floor without inversion or division by width; the delivered wall still passes through deadband and step-cap handling.

rows.label: case:epoch:canonical-interim-wall-controller-positive-width
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:epoch:canonical-interim-wall-controller``: At positive completed width W, propose the maximum of the structural floor and inverse deployed gain at 1/(2 times margin times chartered cumulative tilt times W). This targets the least mathematically passing wall; finite boundary comparisons may be indecisive and the next epoch certifies its own width.

rows.label: case:epoch:canonical-interim-wall-controller-deadband-hold
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:epoch:canonical-interim-wall-controller``: When the target error magnitude is at most deadband times the previous wall, set the effective error to zero and hold the wall, including equality.

rows.label: case:epoch:canonical-interim-wall-controller-deadband-move
rows.statement: Branch of ``def:epoch:canonical-interim-wall-controller``: Outside the relative deadband, retain the signed target error and move by at most its magnitude, the absolute step and the relative step times the previous wall. Apply proposal, floor, deadband and cap in that order; publish proposal and delivered wall with one-boundary lead.

rows.label: prop:epoch:safety-independent-of-controller
rows.statement: Under the conserved-map ledger, support and invariant-box hypotheses, every finite wall at or above its structural floor has a greatest proved passing rung on the completed epoch’s own width, with a unique fixed point and geometric convergence from its box. This does not require a correct controller forecast or attainment of the chartered rung, and does not discharge the separate write and policy tests.

rows.label: case:epoch:safety-independent-of-controller-nonempty-domain
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:epoch:safety-independent-of-controller`` proof: On a nonempty finite live domain under the standing hypotheses, a positive finite wall gives finite gain, and the finite grid includes the zero-certificate anchor. The nonempty finite set of proved passes has a greatest rung; its contraction gives unique standing and geometric convergence without a next-epoch width-dominance premise.

rows.label: case:epoch:safety-independent-of-controller-empty-domain
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:epoch:safety-independent-of-controller`` proof: On an empty live domain, the standing box contains only the empty vector, which is the unique fixed point. This does not discharge own-balance, individual-safety, epoch-admission or policy-validity tests.

rows.label: prop:epoch:wall-controller-total
rows.statement: Define empty-domain width as zero and otherwise use the maximum contributing source-rate range. On every finite declared input triple, the canonical interim controller must return a finite proposal and delivered wall at or above the floor, obeying the step bound. Zero width proposes the floor, and a wall already there stays there.

rows.label: prop:epoch:wall-controller-covariance
rows.statement: Under recoinage, co-scale burn values and numeraire while retaining reduced constants and counts: reduced rates, standing, width and wall stay unchanged, the next price co-scales, and old debits change representation only. A fixed-ledger numeraire migration instead evaluates the controller on its published transformed inputs; same-pair width scales inversely, compensation preserves the door product, an uncompensated move keeps its declared policy schedule, and floor and policy tests still apply. No controller homogeneity or solvency and individual-safety invariance is promised for that migration.

rows.label: case:epoch:wall-controller-covariance-recoinage
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:epoch:wall-controller-covariance``: For recoinage by positive c, co-scale every burn-denominated value and the numeraire while retaining reduced constants and counts; reduced ledger, standing, width and wall are unchanged, and the next price scales by c. Recorded debit changes are representational, not repricing.

rows.label: case:epoch:wall-controller-covariance-fixed-ledger-migration
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:epoch:wall-controller-covariance``: For numeraire migration by c at a fixed burn ledger, evaluate the controller on the published transformed wall, width and rung, then multiply by the new numeraire for price. The same fixed source pairs have width W/c; this is not a forecast for an epoch with different debits.

rows.label: case:epoch:wall-controller-covariance-compensated
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:epoch:wall-controller-covariance``: Compensated fixed-ledger migration also divides the policy floor by c so the numeraire-door product remains invariant. Validate the published wall floor and policy values; the product identity does not assert controller homogeneity or invariant write gates.

rows.label: case:epoch:wall-controller-covariance-uncompensated
rows.statement: Branch of ``prop:epoch:wall-controller-covariance``: Uncompensated fixed-ledger migration retains its declared policy schedule. Apply wall-floor and policy-validity tests to the published values; do not assume controller homogeneity or invariance of own-balance and individual-safety tests.

rows.label: def:epoch:final-act-stamps
rows.statement: Give every same-author act the final standing stamp and aggregate once per act.

rows.label: eq:epoch:final-action-stamp
rows.statement: Assign the author's reduced equilibrium to each complete act.

rows.label: eq:epoch:final-epoch-stamp
rows.statement: Average final stamps by accepted authored-act count.

rows.label: eq:epoch:final-epoch-headroom
rows.statement: Sum action-weighted excess over the effective floor. Headroom is a measurement, not a floor or debit. Matched partitions preserve gates only with sufficient clearance and separately valid admission premises; the fixtures show no admission flip. Partition-stability guarantees require the clearance premises of ``prop:epoch:split-admission-clearance``.

rows.label: post:epoch:reduction-convention
rows.statement: Reduce dynamics by the numeraire and keep door and wall read-sites distinct.

rows.label: prop:epoch:compensation
rows.statement: Co-scale numeraire and reduced price inversely to preserve their door-price product; inverse width scaling and fence-certificate degradation both require the declared law of the comparison family. Neither scaling nor degradation follows from the door-product identity.

rows.label: rem:epoch:capacity-crush
rows.statement: Never reprice consummated historical debits.

rows.label: rem:epoch:two-axes
rows.statement: Keep dimensionless policy and burn-denominated safety quantities distinct.

rows.label: rem:epoch:dial-scope
rows.statement: Separate structural numeraire, policy floor and certificate margin from measured headroom.

rows.label: rem:epoch:operator-authority-floor
rows.statement: Limit host floor authority to the announced valid policy schedule.

rows.label: sec:sorting
rows.statement: Track sorting as a separately addressable section.

rows.label: subsec:sorting:relevance-score
rows.statement: Track relevance score as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:sorting:relevance-score
rows.statement: Combine raw max-product relevance, fixed creator standing and terminal content norm.

rows.label: eq:sorting:relevance-score
rows.statement: Combine raw max-product relevance, fixed creator standing and terminal content norm. Fixed-context scalar monotonicity supplies no general burn-response, partition, ranking or end-to-end reward guarantee. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: rem:sorting:final-standing-input
rows.statement: Expose final reduced creator standing without exposing solver intermediates to sorting. With other feed factors fixed, certified scalar changes bound score movement; burn, act and partition interventions require separate field and context comparisons. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: rem:sorting:terminal-routing-asymmetry
rows.statement: Use directional coherence for routing and scalar energy at a content terminus.

rows.label: prop:sorting:score-positivity
rows.statement: Require a viable positive-weight path for a positive content score.

rows.label: prop:sorting:weak-link-suppression
rows.statement: Bound the score by the weakest determinant factor on the chosen path.

rows.label: subsec:sorting:log-transform-equivalence
rows.statement: Track log transform equivalence as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:sorting:log-relevance-distance
rows.statement: Minimize summed negative log raw weights.

rows.label: eq:sorting:log-relevance-distance
rows.statement: Minimize summed negative log raw weights.

rows.label: eq:sorting:log-cost-decomposition
rows.statement: Separate coherence cost, maturity discount and entropy penalty.

rows.label: thm:sorting:log-transform-equivalence
rows.statement: Relate positive max-product paths to minimum log-cost paths.

rows.label: eq:sorting:log-equivalence
rows.statement: Equate the maximizing product and minimizing log sum.

rows.label: case:sorting:log-transform-equivalence-routing-active
rows.statement: Branch of ``thm:sorting:log-transform-equivalence`` proof: On routing-active raw edges, positive weights admit the negative-log transform: maximizing a path product is equivalent to minimizing its additive log cost over the same admissible paths. This is a raw-path reduction, not standing transport.

rows.label: case:sorting:log-transform-equivalence-routing-inert
rows.statement: Branch of ``thm:sorting:log-transform-equivalence`` proof: A routing-inert edge contributes zero path product and has infinite negative-log cost, so it is excluded from the shortest-path reduction.

rows.label: subsec:sorting:anisotropy
rows.statement: Track anisotropy as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: prop:sorting:anisotropy-penalty
rows.statement: Compute the condition-number penalty against Frobenius scoring.

rows.label: eq:sorting:anisotropy-penalty
rows.statement: Compute the condition-number penalty against Frobenius scoring.

rows.label: subsec:sorting:algorithms
rows.statement: Track algorithms as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: alg:sorting:exact-feed-traversal
rows.statement: Expose bounded-depth raw traversal without designing terminal ranking policy.

rows.label: lem:sorting:bfs-correctness
rows.statement: Check the bounded-depth raw result against exhaustive small-graph enumeration.

rows.label: rem:sorting:matrix-bfs
rows.statement: Nondefault terminal diversity requires matrix propagation.

rows.label: rem:sorting:raw-pruning-is-implementation
rows.statement: Allow optimizations only when they preserve exact declared raw outputs.

rows.label: rem:sorting:mc-estimator-semantics
rows.statement: Keep sum-of-path estimates distinct from maximum-path relevance.

rows.label: alg:sorting:monte-carlo-sum-of-paths
rows.statement: Inventory the terminal random-walk estimator without adding Layer 1 sampling.

rows.label: thm:sorting:monte-carlo-concentration
rows.statement: Inventory the claimed concentration bound under bounded independent samples.

rows.label: cor:sorting:boundary-tightening
rows.statement: Inventory the stated entropy-dependent sampling bound.

rows.label: rem:sorting:diagnostic-cost
rows.statement: Compute terminal path diagnostics after ranking without feeding them into standing.

rows.label: subsec:sorting:cross-cluster-amplification
rows.statement: Track cross cluster amplification as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: thm:sorting:cross-cluster-amplification
rows.statement: Inventory the raw maturity amplification ratio and its threshold claim.

rows.label: eq:sorting:cross-cluster-amplification
rows.statement: Inventory the raw maturity amplification ratio and its threshold claim.

rows.label: cor:sorting:serendipity-conditions
rows.statement: Inventory the claimed maturity and coherence requirements for cross-cluster discovery.

rows.label: cor:sorting:polarized-cluster-amplification
rows.statement: Inventory the terminal amplification claim from polarization.

rows.label: subsec:sorting:score-monotonicity
rows.statement: Track score monotonicity as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: thm:sorting:score-monotonicity
rows.statement: Inventory the stated terminal score monotonicity conditions.

rows.label: itm:sorting:score-monotonicity-standing
rows.statement: With every other feed factor fixed, score is nondecreasing in published creator standing. That scalar-input derivative supplies no universal burn or act response, partition invariance or ranking guarantee.

rows.label: itm:sorting:score-monotonicity-quality
rows.statement: With other score inputs fixed, require feed score to be nondecreasing in the content tensor’s Frobenius norm.

rows.label: itm:sorting:score-monotonicity-coherence
rows.statement: With other score inputs fixed, require feed score to be nondecreasing in the absolute path-view determinant of any path edge.

rows.label: itm:sorting:score-monotonicity-maturity
rows.statement: Treat feed maturity response as non-monotone, with the stated minimum near one half and net amplification only beyond the maturity crossing.

rows.label: itm:sorting:score-monotonicity-entropy
rows.statement: With other score inputs fixed, require feed score to be nonincreasing in tensor entropy.

rows.label: itm:sorting:score-monotonicity-diversity
rows.statement: For positive diversity preference and fixed other score inputs, require feed score to be nondecreasing in the second singular value.

rows.label: itm:sorting:score-monotonicity-focus
rows.statement: For positive diversity preference, require the score’s condition-number derivative to be nonpositive when the first singular value exceeds the second; the isotropic case is excluded from that premise.

rows.label: itm:sorting:score-monotonicity-profile-bridge
rows.statement: On a fixed raw profile-bridged feed path, score is nondecreasing in the creator’s published standing through both the raw bridge factor and terminal amplifier. This is not a standing-transport property; burn or act changes require a separate completed-field comparison. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: sec:transport
rows.statement: Track transport as a separately addressable section.

rows.label: subsec:transport:commitment-via-burn
rows.statement: Track commitment via burn as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: def:transport:commitment-via-burn
rows.statement: Read nonnegative cumulative burn amounts and inherited settlement properties through the burn interface.

rows.label: rem:transport:burn-granularity
rows.statement: Represent reduced source rates to at least eight significant figures without treating rounded gates as valid.

rows.label: subsec:transport:guild-model
rows.statement: Track guild model as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: post:transport:guild-grant
rows.statement: Permit terminal guild reinterpretations within the declared grant constraints, without changing binding standing or inferring that funding increases standing or preserves terminal context. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: rem:transport:guild-grant-preconditions
rows.statement: Guilds may reinterpret terminal commercial assertions but cannot replace the title fold or standing recipient rule; unrecognized, challenged or non-transferring settlements resolve to self, without a promised terminal remedy.

rows.label: rem:transport:guild-grant-cases
rows.statement: Guild choices are terminal reimplementations with public rules and canonical defaults; every CAN replacement retains depth decay, transmission below one and context independence without changing binding values or closure.

rows.label: case:transport:membership-policy
rows.statement: Branch of ``rem:transport:guild-grant-cases``: Choose a published terminal membership and sorting policy; the canonical fold admits participation and departure; De-invites are advisory unless recognized by a published policy, without conditioning admission, departure or De-invite authoring.

rows.label: case:transport:deep-composition
rows.statement: Branch of ``rem:transport:guild-grant-cases``: Choose composition depth and scalar or matrix representation; the default scalar CAN follows the dependency DAG, and every choice preserves depth decay, transmission below one and context independence.

rows.label: case:transport:svd-corrected-transmission
rows.statement: Branch of ``rem:transport:guild-grant-cases``: Optionally replace saturated mean edge norms by the saturated top singular value of the mean matrix; the full recursion must retain the CAN invariants.

rows.label: case:transport:can-aggregation-function
rows.statement: Branch of ``rem:transport:guild-grant-cases``: Choose the aggregation function; arithmetic mean is canonical, while alternatives must preserve depth decay, strict transmission and context independence.

rows.label: case:transport:bridge-multi-bridge
rows.statement: Branch of ``rem:transport:guild-grant-cases``: Choose public bridge composition and attribution; the canonical single-bridge rule takes the outer maximum per recipient, and replacements must re-establish any claimed canonical guarantees.

rows.label: case:transport:bridge-eligibility-cliff
rows.statement: Branch of ``rem:transport:guild-grant-cases``: A guild chooses smoothing, with the unsmoothed single-bridge maximum as canonical default; a replacement accounts for redundancy amplification and inherits or re-derives each canonical guarantee it claims. Separately, the centralized-phase operator publishes an argmax-flip-rate threshold and a share-volatility companion, the ℓ1 distance between consecutive normalized share vectors, both computable from epoch-certificate data. Exceeding the threshold obliges the operator to publish a reference top-k ensemble composition rule; its use remains terminal and optional under the guild grant. This publication is a required policy; the implementation home is held in (`open:inventory:bridge-reaction-placement`).

rows.label: case:transport:bridge-delivery-semantics
rows.statement: Branch of ``rem:transport:guild-grant-cases``: Use the canonical campaign scalar as circuit quality; privately observed traversal supplies no self-sufficient record, and adding a navigation edge type lies outside the terminal grant.

rows.label: case:transport:notoriety-field
rows.statement: Branch of ``rem:transport:guild-grant-cases``: Optionally declare a terminal negative aggregation; the canonical choice has no separate field, retains public negative records outside standing endorsement and gives them no feedback into admission or standing.

rows.label: rem:transport:guild-economic-autonomy
rows.statement: Leave payout units, margins and pool funding to published guild policy.

rows.label: subsec:transport:advertiser-objective
rows.statement: Track advertiser objective as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: eq:transport:campaign-scalar
rows.statement: Inventory the terminal weighted best-circuit campaign score.

rows.label: rem:transport:actor-targets
rows.statement: Restrict the canonical advertiser target population to actors.

rows.label: subsec:transport:reward-formula
rows.statement: Track reward formula as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: eq:transport:reward-formula
rows.statement: Inventory the normalized terminal reward formula and its positive-improvement gate. With fixed creators, positive normalization and fixed non-standing factors, conditional input bounds apply; they establish no general burn or funded-partition reward effect. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: tbl:transport:layer-origins
rows.statement: Expose records, scalar standing and geometry as inputs without implementing rewards.

rows.label: eq:transport:epoch-entropy
rows.statement: Average creator edge entropy for the terminal reward factor.

rows.label: rem:transport:cross-channel-commitment-amplification
rows.statement: Expose certified standing as a fixed scalar rather than a replaceable raw-graph recomputation. Feed attention and pool funds reuse that scalar as distinct resources, not a double count; fixed-context sensitivity implies no monotone burn or act response. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: subsec:transport:properties
rows.statement: Track properties as a separately addressable subsection.

rows.label: pty:transport:final-standing-input-monotonicity
rows.statement: With other creator-varying factors fixed, canonical reward share is nondecreasing in the published reduced-standing input through one plus that input. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: prop:transport:standing-readout-bounds
rows.statement: Bound feed and normalized reward sensitivity only with the specified creators, factors, pool and gate fixed and positive normalization; this is not an end-to-end burn, partition or ranking guarantee. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: cor:transport:zero-reward
rows.statement: Assign zero canonical reward when campaign improvement is nonpositive.

rows.label: thm:transport:epoch-entropy-damping
rows.statement: For a positive gate and pool with other factors and competing entropies fixed and a positive denominator, increasing own entropy never increases reward. Decrease is strict only with positive own and competing contributions; zero and sole contributions give equality, and an all-zero denominator gives no allocation claim.

rows.label: thm:transport:reward-proportionality
rows.statement: Inventory proportional terminal allocation among contributing creators. Use composite utility under the open improvement gate and positive normalization; a partition comparison must hold its terminal context fixed and supplies no end-to-end reward guarantee. Partition readout bounds require the matched creators and fixed non-standing context of ``prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds``.

rows.label: prop:transport:split-terminal-readout-bounds
rows.statement: Translate partition standing bounds into terminal bounds only with creators and all non-standing factors matched; changed authorship, paths, attribution and guild factors need separate hypotheses. Use the declared matched-history contract of ``def:epoch:actor-partition-comparison``; do not infer its fibre or counterfactual from the record.

rows.statement: No appendix entry meets the Layer-1 open-problem criterion.

These six architectural extensions leave no Layer-1 open problem and grant no permission to alter the current charter.

The operative fence remains authoritative; no implementation chooses whichever gate passes.
